<canvas id="scene" role="img" aria-label="A single steaming bowl of vegan ramen resting on a dark wooden table in warm atmospheric light"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  'use strict';

  const canvas = document.getElementById('scene');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });

  // =========================================================================
  // Deterministic PRNG & Smooth 2D Value / Curl Noise
  // =========================================================================
  function mulberry32(seed) {
    let a = seed >>> 0;
    return function () {
      a |= 0;
      a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0;
      let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
      t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    };
  }

  const PERM = new Uint8Array(512);
  const VALS = new Float32Array(256);
  (() => {
    const rng = mulberry32(20261118);
    const p = new Uint8Array(256);
    for (let i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
      p[i] = i;
      VALS[i] = rng() * 2 - 1;
    }
    for (let i = 255; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = (rng() * (i + 1)) | 0;
      const tmp = p[i];
      p[i] = p[j];
      p[j] = tmp;
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < 512; i++) PERM[i] = p[i & 255];
  })();

  function fade(t) {
    return t * t * t * (t * (t * 6 - 15) + 10);
  }
  function lerp(a, b, t) {
    return a + (b - a) * t;
  }
  function clamp(v, lo, hi) {
    return v < lo ? lo : v > hi ? hi : v;
  }
  function smoothstep(e0, e1, x) {
    const t = clamp((x - e0) / (e1 - e0), 0, 1);
    return t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
  }

  function noise2D(x, y) {
    const xi = Math.floor(x);
    const yi = Math.floor(y);
    const xf = x - xi;
    const yf = y - yi;
    const u = fade(xf);
    const v = fade(yf);
    const X = xi & 255;
    const Y = yi & 255;
    const aa = VALS[PERM[PERM[X] + Y]];
    const ba = VALS[PERM[PERM[X + 1] + Y]];
    const ab = VALS[PERM[PERM[X] + Y + 1]];
    const bb = VALS[PERM[PERM[X + 1] + Y + 1]];
    return lerp(lerp(aa, ba, u), lerp(ab, bb, u), v);
  }

  function fbm2D(x, y, octaves) {
    let val = 0;
    let amp = 0.5;
    let freq = 1;
    for (let i = 0; i < octaves; i++) {
      val += amp * noise2D(x * freq, y * freq);
      freq *= 2.03;
      amp *= 0.5;
    }
    return val;
  }

  function curlNoise(x, y, t) {
    const eps = 0.04;
    const n1 = fbm2D(x, y + eps + t * 0.12, 2);
    const n2 = fbm2D(x, y - eps + t * 0.12, 2);
    const n3 = fbm2D(x + eps + t * 0.05, y, 2);
    const n4 = fbm2D(x - eps + t * 0.05, y, 2);
    return {
      vx: (n1 - n2) / (2 * eps),
      vy: -(n3 - n4) / (2 * eps)
    };
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Reduced Motion & Viewport State
  // =========================================================================
  const reducedMotionMQ = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  let reducedMotion = reducedMotionMQ.matches;

  let W = 0;
  let H = 0;
  let dpr = 1;
  let rafId = null;
  let lastTime = 0;
  let elapsed = 0;

  // Bowl layout geometry in CSS pixels
  const L = {
    cx: 0,
    cy: 0,
    R: 200,
    ryRatio: 0.58,
    rimRx: 200,
    rimRy: 116,
    innerRx: 186,
    innerRy: 108,
    innerOffY: 3,
    brothOffY: 16,
    brothRx: 177,
    brothRy: 102,
    bowlDepth: 170
  };

  // Interactive Pointer State
  const ptr = {
    rawX: 0,
    rawY: 0,
    x: 0,
    y: 0,
    nx: 0,     // normalized [-1, 1] relative to bowl center
    ny: 0,
    vx: 0,
    vy: 0,
    active: false,
    overBroth: false,
    warmthBoost: 0,
    lastRippleX: 0,
    lastRippleY: 0,
    lastRippleT: 0
  };

  // Air wake vortices generated by mouse movement
  const wakes = [];
  // Concentric ripples on broth surface
  const ripples = [];

  // =========================================================================
  // Offscreen Procedural Asset Caches
  // =========================================================================
  const cache = {
    backdrop: null,
    bowlBack: null,
    bowlFrontLip: null,
    brothBase: null,
    steamBrushes: [],
    shiitakeA: null,
    shiitakeB: null,
    tofuA: null,
    tofuB: null,
    lotusA: null,
    lotusB: null,
    bokChoy: null,
    noriBack: null,
    noriFront: null,
    builtR: 0,
    builtW: 0,
    builtH: 0
  };

  function makeCanvas(w, h) {
    const c = document.createElement('canvas');
    c.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(w));
    c.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(h));
    return c;
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 1. Steam Brush Textures (Organic Feathered Vapor Clouds)
  // =========================================================================
  function buildSteamBrushes() {
    cache.steamBrushes = [];
    for (let b = 0; b < 3; b++) {
      const s = 128;
      const c = makeCanvas(s, s);
      const g = c.getContext('2d');
      const rng = mulberry32(9001 + b * 137);
      const cx = s * 0.5;
      const cy = s * 0.5;

      // Soft central core
      const baseGrad = g.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, s * 0.46);
      baseGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 246, 232, 0.34)');
      baseGrad.addColorStop(0.45, 'rgba(255, 242, 224, 0.14)');
      baseGrad.addColorStop(0.8, 'rgba(240, 234, 226, 0.03)');
      baseGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(240, 234, 226, 0)');
      g.fillStyle = baseGrad;
      g.fillRect(0, 0, s, s);

      // Organic soft asymmetric sub-lobes for wispy smoke character
      for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        const ang = (i / 8) * Math.PI * 2 + rng() * 0.6;
        const dist = s * (0.08 + rng() * 0.16);
        const lx = cx + Math.cos(ang) * dist;
        const ly = cy + Math.sin(ang) * dist;
        const lr = s * (0.16 + rng() * 0.18);
        const lg = g.createRadialGradient(lx, ly, 0, lx, ly, lr);
        lg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 245, 230, 0.16)');
        lg.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(250, 240, 226, 0.05)');
        lg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(245, 238, 230, 0)');
        g.fillStyle = lg;
        g.beginPath();
        g.arc(lx, ly, lr, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        g.fill();
      }
      cache.steamBrushes.push(c);
    }
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 2. Dark Izakaya Backdrop & Charred Yakisugi Wood Counter
  // =========================================================================
  function buildBackdropCache() {
    const pad = 44; // extra margin for smooth parallax shift
    const cw = Math.ceil((W + pad * 2) * dpr);
    const ch = Math.ceil((H + pad * 2) * dpr);
    const c = makeCanvas(cw, ch);
    const g = c.getContext('2d');
    g.scale(dpr, dpr);
    g.translate(pad, pad);

    const cx = L.cx;
    const cy = L.cy;
    const R = L.R;

    // Deep moody warm obsidian void
    const bgGrad = g.createRadialGradient(
      cx - R * 0.1, cy - R * 0.55, R * 0.1,
      cx, cy - R * 0.1, Math.max(W, H) * 0.92
    );
    bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1e150e');
    bgGrad.addColorStop(0.28, '#130e0a');
    bgGrad.addColorStop(0.62, '#0a0806');
    bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#040303');
    g.fillStyle = bgGrad;
    g.fillRect(-pad, -pad, W + pad * 2, H + pad * 2);

    // Subtle dark charred cedar (yakisugi) wood counter plane receding into darkness
    const tableTop = cy - R * 0.48;
    const tableH = H + pad - tableTop;

    const tblGrad = g.createLinearGradient(0, tableTop, 0, H + pad);
    tblGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(10, 7, 5, 0)');
    tblGrad.addColorStop(0.18, 'rgba(22, 16, 12, 0.72)');
    tblGrad.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(28, 20, 14, 0.92)');
    tblGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(14, 10, 8, 1)');
    g.fillStyle = tblGrad;
    g.fillRect(-pad, tableTop, W + pad * 2, tableH);

    // Subtle horizontal wood grain streaks emerging softly in the warm lit zone
    g.save();
    g.beginPath();
    g.rect(-pad, tableTop, W + pad * 2, tableH);
    g.clip();

    const rng = mulberry32(4242);
    const lines = 70;
    for (let i = 0; i < lines; i++) {
      const frac = i / lines;
      // Perspective density: tighter near horizon, wider toward foreground
      const y = tableTop + Math.pow(frac, 1.45) * tableH;
      const distFromBowlY = Math.abs(y - (cy + R * 0.55)) / (R * 1.4);
      const vis = clamp(1 - distFromBowlY * 0.65, 0.08, 1) * smoothstep(0, 0.22, frac);
      const isLight = rng() > 0.45;
      g.strokeStyle = isLight
        ? `rgba(125, 86, 52, ${(0.018 + rng() * 0.028) * vis})`
        : `rgba(4, 2, 1, ${(0.12 + rng() * 0.16) * vis})`;
      g.lineWidth = 0.7 + frac * (1.2 + rng() * 2.2);
      g.beginPath();
      const waveFreq = 0.002 + rng() * 0.004;
      const waveAmp = 1.5 + rng() * 4.5 * frac;
      const phase = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
      for (let x = -pad; x <= W + pad; x += 28) {
        const wy = y + Math.sin(x * waveFreq + phase) * waveAmp + noise2D(x * 0.008, i * 0.7) * 2.5;
        if (x === -pad) g.moveTo(x, wy);
        else g.lineTo(x, wy);
      }
      g.stroke();
    }

    // Subtle plank join seam far in the foreground or midground
    const seamY = cy + R * 1.05;
    if (seamY < H) {
      g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(3, 2, 1, 0.35)';
      g.lineWidth = 1.4;
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(-pad, seamY);
      g.lineTo(W + pad, seamY);
      g.stroke();
      g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(130, 88, 52, 0.05)';
      g.lineWidth = 1;
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(-pad, seamY + 1.4);
      g.lineTo(W + pad, seamY + 1.4);
      g.stroke();
    }
    g.restore();

    // Warm overhead pendant light pool reflected across the dark counter
    const poolX = cx - R * 0.06;
    const poolY = cy + R * 0.48;
    g.save();
    g.translate(poolX, poolY);
    g.scale(1.65, 0.62);
    const poolGrad = g.createRadialGradient(0, 0, R * 0.25, 0, 0, R * 1.38);
    poolGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(205, 128, 56, 0.19)');
    poolGrad.addColorStop(0.42, 'rgba(155, 88, 34, 0.10)');
    poolGrad.addColorStop(0.75, 'rgba(90, 48, 18, 0.035)');
    poolGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
    g.fillStyle = poolGrad;
    g.beginPath();
    g.arc(0, 0, R * 1.38, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.fill();
    g.restore();

    cache.backdrop = { canvas: c, pad };
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 3. Handcrafted Dark Tenmoku Stoneware Bowl (Exterior + Inner Wall + Front Lip)
  // =========================================================================
  function buildBowlCaches() {
    const R = L.R;
    const ry = L.rimRy;
    const depth = L.bowlDepth;
    const margin = Math.ceil(R * 0.35);
    const w = Math.ceil(R * 2 + margin * 2);
    const h = Math.ceil(ry + depth + margin * 2);
    const ox = w * 0.5;
    const oy = ry + margin;

    // --- Bowl Back / Full Exterior + Inner Cavity ---
    const c = makeCanvas(w * dpr, h * dpr);
    const g = c.getContext('2d');
    g.scale(dpr, dpr);
    g.translate(ox, oy);

    // Helper: bowl outer body path (starts at right rim, sweeps down to foot ring, up to left rim, closes across back rim)
    const footW = R * 0.415;
    const footY = depth * 0.94;
    const footRimY = depth * 1.0;

    function traceBowlBody(ctx2) {
      ctx2.beginPath();
      ctx2.moveTo(R, 0);
      // Right sculpted curve down to foot junction
      ctx2.bezierCurveTo(
        R * 0.99, depth * 0.46,
        R * 0.72, depth * 0.80,
        footW * 1.05, footY - depth * 0.04
      );
      // Slight indentation into ceramic foot ring (kodai)
      ctx2.lineTo(footW, footRimY - depth * 0.03);
      // Foot base gentle arc
      ctx2.quadraticCurveTo(0, footRimY + depth * 0.065, -footW, footRimY - depth * 0.03);
      ctx2.lineTo(-footW * 1.05, footY - depth * 0.04);
      // Left sculpted curve up to left rim
      ctx2.bezierCurveTo(
        -R * 0.72, depth * 0.80,
        -R * 0.99, depth * 0.46,
        -R, 0
      );
      // Close over the back rim arc
      ctx2.ellipse(0, 0, R, ry, 0, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2, false);
      ctx2.closePath();
    }

    // 1) Grounded table shadows beneath the bowl
    // Soft elongated ambient cast shadow (key light top-left -> shadow slight right-down)
    g.save();
    g.translate(R * 0.14, footRimY + depth * 0.01);
    g.scale(1.22, 0.38);
    const castGrad = g.createRadialGradient(0, 0, R * 0.18, 0, 0, R * 0.98);
    castGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(2, 1, 0, 0.88)');
    castGrad.addColorStop(0.45, 'rgba(3, 2, 1, 0.56)');
    castGrad.addColorStop(0.78, 'rgba(3, 2, 1, 0.20)');
    castGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(3, 2, 1, 0)');
    g.fillStyle = castGrad;
    g.beginPath();
    g.arc(0, 0, R * 0.98, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.fill();
    g.restore();

    // Tight dark ambient occlusion directly under the foot ring
    g.save();
    g.translate(R * 0.02, footRimY + depth * 0.015);
    g.scale(1.0, 0.34);
    const aoGrad = g.createRadialGradient(0, 0, footW * 0.45, 0, 0, footW * 1.25);
    aoGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.96)');
    aoGrad.addColorStop(0.75, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.72)');
    aoGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
    g.fillStyle = aoGrad;
    g.beginPath();
    g.arc(0, 0, footW * 1.25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.fill();
    g.restore();

    // 2) Exterior Ceramic Body Shading
    g.save();
    traceBowlBody(g);
    g.clip();

    // Base Tenmoku iron-black stoneware directional fill
    const bodyGrad = g.createRadialGradient(
      -R * 0.42, depth * 0.16, R * 0.05,
      R * 0.08, depth * 0.38, R * 1.38
    );
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#3a2d24');
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.28, '#261e19');
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.62, '#16110e');
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.88, '#0c0908');
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#121215');
    g.fillStyle = bodyGrad;
    g.fillRect(-R - 10, -ry - 10, R * 2 + 20, ry + depth + 40);

    // Warm reflected bounce light from the table onto the lower-left belly curve
    const bounceGrad = g.createRadialGradient(
      -R * 0.28, depth * 0.72, R * 0.04,
      -R * 0.18, depth * 0.76, R * 0.62
    );
    bounceGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(186, 114, 54, 0.22)');
    bounceGrad.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(135, 76, 34, 0.08)');
    bounceGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
    g.fillStyle = bounceGrad;
    g.fillRect(-R, 0, R * 2, depth + 20);

    // Subtle cool nocturnal slate rim light on far right ceramic shoulder
    const coolRim = g.createRadialGradient(
      R * 0.94, depth * 0.22, R * 0.02,
      R * 0.85, depth * 0.28, R * 0.46
    );
    coolRim.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(140, 168, 204, 0.18)');
    coolRim.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(110, 136, 172, 0.07)');
    coolRim.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
    g.fillStyle = coolRim;
    g.fillRect(0, -ry, R + 10, depth + ry);

    // Subtle potter's wheel concentric throwing grooves across exterior belly
    const rng = mulberry32(7731);
    for (let i = 0; i < 24; i++) {
      const f = (i + 0.5) / 24;
      const gy = depth * (0.08 + f * 0.80);
      const halfSpan = R * (1.0 - Math.pow(f, 1.75) * 0.54);
      const dropSag = ry * 0.56 * (1 - f * 0.45);
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(-halfSpan, gy - dropSag * 0.25);
      g.quadraticCurveTo(0, gy + dropSag * 0.78, halfSpan, gy - dropSag * 0.25);
      g.strokeStyle = i % 2 === 0
        ? `rgba(255, 224, 190, ${0.016 + rng() * 0.018})`
        : `rgba(0, 0, 0, ${0.12 + rng() * 0.10})`;
      g.lineWidth = 1.0 + rng() * 1.4;
      g.stroke();
    }

    // Natural kiln-fired warm copper-russet glaze shoulder near the rim (Tenmoku oil-spot/iron edge)
    g.save();
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(0, depth * 0.06, R * 1.02, ry * 1.05, 0, 0, Math.PI);
    g.lineTo(-R * 1.05, -ry);
    g.lineTo(R * 1.05, -ry);
    g.closePath();
    const glazeBand = g.createLinearGradient(0, ry * 0.72, 0, ry * 1.24);
    glazeBand.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(128, 72, 36, 0.34)');
    glazeBand.addColorStop(0.45, 'rgba(92, 48, 22, 0.18)');
    glazeBand.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(40, 20, 10, 0)');
    g.fillStyle = glazeBand;
    g.fillRect(-R, 0, R * 2, depth * 0.55);
    g.restore();

    // Foot ring (kodai) unglazed dark stoneware collar shadow
    g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55)';
    g.lineWidth = Math.max(2, R * 0.016);
    g.beginPath();
    g.moveTo(-footW * 1.05, footY - depth * 0.035);
    g.quadraticCurveTo(0, footY + depth * 0.06, footW * 1.05, footY - depth * 0.035);
    g.stroke();

    // Matte ceramic mineral iron speckles across the exterior body
    const speckCount = Math.floor(R * 4.5);
    for (let i = 0; i < speckCount; i++) {
      const sx = (rng() * 2 - 1) * R;
      const sy = rng() * depth;
      const lightSide = smoothstep(R * 0.7, -R * 0.7, sx);
      const sz = 0.5 + rng() * 1.25;
      g.fillStyle = rng() > 0.35
        ? `rgba(215, 175, 138, ${(0.02 + rng() * 0.045) * (0.35 + lightSide * 0.65)})`
        : `rgba(8, 5, 4, ${0.14 + rng() * 0.18})`;
      g.beginPath();
      g.arc(sx, sy, sz, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
    }

    // Soft glossy stoneware vertical sheen patch on left shoulder
    const sheenGrad = g.createRadialGradient(
      -R * 0.56, depth * 0.38, R * 0.02,
      -R * 0.54, depth * 0.42, R * 0.38
    );
    sheenGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 220, 175, 0.14)');
    sheenGrad.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(230, 175, 120, 0.045)');
    sheenGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
    g.fillStyle = sheenGrad;
    g.fillRect(-R, 0, R, depth);

    g.restore();

    // 3) Outer Ceramic Rim Top Surface (full ellipse)
    const rimGrad = g.createLinearGradient(-R, -ry, R, ry);
    rimGrad.addColorStop(0, '#78482a');
    rimGrad.addColorStop(0.26, '#5c3620');
    rimGrad.addColorStop(0.55, '#3b2418');
    rimGrad.addColorStop(0.82, '#241711');
    rimGrad.addColorStop(1, '#4c3e3a');
    g.fillStyle = rimGrad;
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(0, 0, R, ry, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.fill();

    // Subtle crisp top-left kiln-rim specular glint on back rim
    g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 212, 162, 0.38)';
    g.lineWidth = Math.max(1.2, R * 0.008);
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(0, 0, R * 0.985, ry * 0.985, 0, Math.PI * 1.06, Math.PI * 1.56);
    g.stroke();

    // 4) Recessed Inner Ceramic Cavity (visible crescent above broth line)
    g.save();
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(0, L.innerOffY, L.innerRx, L.innerRy, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.clip();

    const innerGrad = g.createLinearGradient(0, -L.innerRy, 0, L.innerRy);
    innerGrad.addColorStop(0, '#17110d');
    innerGrad.addColorStop(0.28, '#281c14');
    innerGrad.addColorStop(0.52, '#3a2515');
    innerGrad.addColorStop(1, '#120c09');
    g.fillStyle = innerGrad;
    g.fillRect(-R, -ry, R * 2, ry * 2 + 20);

    // Warm glowing broth bounce reflection on the curved back inner wall
    const wallBounce = g.createRadialGradient(
      -R * 0.08, L.brothOffY - L.brothRy * 0.72, R * 0.08,
      0, L.brothOffY - L.brothRy * 0.5, R * 0.92
    );
    wallBounce.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(235, 146, 54, 0.28)');
    wallBounce.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(182, 98, 32, 0.12)');
    wallBounce.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
    g.fillStyle = wallBounce;
    g.fillRect(-R, -ry, R * 2, ry * 2);

    // Subtle concentric potter's rings on back inner wall
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      g.strokeStyle = i % 2 === 0 ? 'rgba(255, 215, 165, 0.035)' : 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16)';
      g.lineWidth = 1.2;
      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(0, L.innerOffY + i * R * 0.022, L.innerRx * (0.99 - i * 0.008), L.innerRy * (0.99 - i * 0.008), 0, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
      g.stroke();
    }

    // Inner back-wall mineral speckles
    for (let i = 0; i < 160; i++) {
      const ang = Math.PI + rng() * Math.PI;
      const rad = 0.82 + rng() * 0.18;
      const sx = Math.cos(ang) * L.innerRx * rad;
      const sy = L.innerOffY + Math.sin(ang) * L.innerRy * rad;
      g.fillStyle = `rgba(220, 180, 138, ${0.03 + rng() * 0.05})`;
      g.fillRect(sx, sy, 1.1, 1.1);
    }

    g.restore();

    // Inner lip subtle bevel edge
    g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(20, 12, 8, 0.65)';
    g.lineWidth = Math.max(1.2, R * 0.009);
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(0, L.innerOffY, L.innerRx, L.innerRy, 0, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
    g.stroke();

    // --- Front Ceramic Lip Overlay (clips cleanly over front edge of broth & toppings) ---
    const lf = makeCanvas(w * dpr, h * dpr);
    const fg = lf.getContext('2d');
    fg.scale(dpr, dpr);
    fg.translate(ox, oy);

    // Front rim crescent: outer ellipse minus inner cavity ellipse, restricted to lower half
    fg.save();
    fg.beginPath();
    fg.rect(-R - 10, -2, R * 2 + 20, ry + 30);
    fg.clip();

    fg.beginPath();
    fg.ellipse(0, 0, R, ry, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    fg.ellipse(0, L.innerOffY, L.innerRx, L.innerRy, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2, true);

    const fRimGrad = fg.createLinearGradient(-R, 0, R, ry);
    fRimGrad.addColorStop(0, '#724428');
    fRimGrad.addColorStop(0.28, '#5f3720');
    fRimGrad.addColorStop(0.55, '#462818');
    fRimGrad.addColorStop(0.84, '#2a1a12');
    fRimGrad.addColorStop(1, '#3c3434');
    fg.fillStyle = fRimGrad;
    fg.fill('evenodd');

    // Fine warm glazed highlight along front lip crest
    fg.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 214, 165, 0.42)';
    fg.lineWidth = Math.max(1.3, R * 0.009);
    fg.beginPath();
    fg.ellipse(0, L.innerOffY * 0.4, (R + L.innerRx) * 0.5, (ry + L.innerRy) * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 0.14, Math.PI * 0.86);
    fg.stroke();

    // Crisp dark shadow right under inner front lip
    fg.strokeStyle = 'rgba(12, 6, 3, 0.55)';
    fg.lineWidth = Math.max(1.1, R * 0.007);
    fg.beginPath();
    fg.ellipse(0, L.innerOffY, L.innerRx, L.innerRy, 0, 0.03, Math.PI - 0.03);
    fg.stroke();

    fg.restore();

    cache.bowlBack = { canvas: c, ox, oy };
    cache.bowlFrontLip = { canvas: lf, ox, oy };
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 4. Rich Creamy Golden-Amber Miso-Sesame Broth Base Cache
  // =========================================================================
  function buildBrothBaseCache() {
    const rx = L.brothRx;
    const ry = L.brothRy;
    const pad = 12;
    const w = Math.ceil((rx + pad) * 2);
    const h = Math.ceil((ry + pad) * 2);
    const ox = w * 0.5;
    const oy = h * 0.5;

    const c = makeCanvas(w * dpr, h * dpr);
    const g = c.getContext('2d');
    g.scale(dpr, dpr);
    g.translate(ox, oy);

    g.save();
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(0, 0, rx, ry, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.clip();

    // Luminous warm golden-amber creamy miso-paitan radial gradient
    g.save();
    g.scale(1, ry / rx);
    const bGrad = g.createRadialGradient(
      -rx * 0.14, -rx * 0.10, rx * 0.06,
      rx * 0.02, rx * 0.02, rx * 1.05
    );
    bGrad.addColorStop(0, '#e99d3b');
    bGrad.addColorStop(0.28, '#cf7920');
    bGrad.addColorStop(0.58, '#9e4f13');
    bGrad.addColorStop(0.84, '#6b2e0a');
    bGrad.addColorStop(1, '#3d1705');
    g.fillStyle = bGrad;
    g.fillRect(-rx - 4, -rx - 4, rx * 2 + 8, rx * 2 + 8);
    g.restore();

    // Creamy sesame-miso tare cloud marbling (gives genuine rich velvety broth texture!)
    const rng = mulberry32(31415);
    for (let i = 0; i < 65; i++) {
      const ang = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
      const dist = Math.sqrt(rng()) * 0.88;
      const mx = Math.cos(ang) * rx * dist;
      const my = Math.sin(ang) * ry * dist;
      const mr = rx * (0.09 + rng() * 0.20);
      const isWarmCream = rng() > 0.34;
      g.save();
      g.translate(mx, my);
      g.rotate(rng() * Math.PI);
      g.scale(1.4, 0.65);
      const mg = g.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, mr);
      if (isWarmCream) {
        mg.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 206, 118, ${0.065 + rng() * 0.075})`);
        mg.addColorStop(0.55, `rgba(225, 148, 54, ${0.03 + rng() * 0.03})`);
        mg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(225, 148, 54, 0)');
      } else {
        mg.addColorStop(0, `rgba(74, 26, 6, ${0.08 + rng() * 0.09})`);
        mg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(74, 26, 6, 0)');
      }
      g.fillStyle = mg;
      g.beginPath();
      g.arc(0, 0, mr, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
      g.restore();
    }

    // Fine organic miso micro-specks suspended in the broth
    for (let i = 0; i < 240; i++) {
      const ang = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
      const dist = Math.sqrt(rng()) * 0.94;
      const sx = Math.cos(ang) * rx * dist;
      const sy = Math.sin(ang) * ry * dist;
      g.fillStyle = rng() > 0.4
        ? `rgba(115, 45, 10, ${0.12 + rng() * 0.16})`
        : `rgba(255, 214, 138, ${0.08 + rng() * 0.12})`;
      g.beginPath();
      g.arc(sx, sy, 0.7 + rng() * 1.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
    }

    // Subtle warm sunlit subsurface core bloom
    g.save();
    g.scale(1, ry / rx);
    const bloom = g.createRadialGradient(-rx * 0.12, -rx * 0.08, 0, -rx * 0.08, -rx * 0.05, rx * 0.62);
    bloom.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 224, 142, 0.26)');
    bloom.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(245, 170, 68, 0.08)');
    bloom.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(245, 170, 68, 0)');
    g.fillStyle = bloom;
    g.fillRect(-rx, -rx, rx * 2, rx * 2);
    g.restore();

    // Inner meniscus shadow & subtle bright rim along outer broth perimeter
    g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(28, 9, 2, 0.55)';
    g.lineWidth = Math.max(3, rx * 0.025);
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(0, 0, rx - 1, ry - 1, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.stroke();

    g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 206, 128, 0.34)';
    g.lineWidth = Math.max(1.2, rx * 0.008);
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(0, 0, rx - Math.max(2, rx * 0.012), ry - Math.max(1.5, ry * 0.014), 0, Math.PI * 1.04, Math.PI * 1.94);
    g.stroke();

    g.restore();

    cache.brothBase = { canvas: c, ox, oy };
  }

  // --- A. Scored Shiitake Mushroom Cap (Kazari-giri star carving) ---
  function buildShiitakeSprite(radius, seed) {
    const rng = mulberry32(seed);
    const w = Math.ceil(radius * 2.8);
    const h = Math.ceil(radius * 2.4);
    const ox = w * 0.5;
    const oy = h * 0.52;
    const c = makeCanvas(w * dpr, h * dpr);
    const g = c.getContext('2d');
    g.scale(dpr, dpr);
    g.translate(ox, oy);

    // Soft broth contact shadow & warm meniscus aura
    g.save();
    g.scale(1.08, 0.78);
    const sh = g.createRadialGradient(radius * 0.08, radius * 0.22, radius * 0.4, radius * 0.08, radius * 0.22, radius * 1.25);
    sh.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(38, 13, 3, 0.62)');
    sh.addColorStop(0.65, 'rgba(54, 20, 5, 0.28)');
    sh.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(54, 20, 5, 0)');
    g.fillStyle = sh;
    g.beginPath();
    g.arc(radius * 0.08, radius * 0.22, radius * 1.25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.fill();
    g.restore();

    // Slightly visible creamy ribbed underside along the lower-right tilted lip
    g.save();
    g.fillStyle = '#a87d52';
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(radius * 0.06, radius * 0.22, radius * 0.92, radius * 0.62, 0.06, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.fill();
    g.restore();

    // Organic plump dome silhouette (slightly irregular polygon smoothed)
    function traceCap(ctx2, scaleX, scaleY) {
      const pts = 24;
      ctx2.beginPath();
      for (let i = 0; i <= pts; i++) {
        const a = (i / pts) * Math.PI * 2;
        const wob = 1 + Math.sin(a * 3 + seed) * 0.032 + Math.cos(a * 5 + seed * 1.7) * 0.018;
        const px = Math.cos(a) * radius * scaleX * wob;
        const py = Math.sin(a) * radius * scaleY * wob - radius * 0.04;
        if (i === 0) ctx2.moveTo(px, py);
        else ctx2.lineTo(px, py);
      }
      ctx2.closePath();
    }

    g.save();
    traceCap(g, 1.0, 0.74);
    g.clip();

    // Deep velvety mahogany-chestnut dome gradient
    const capGrad = g.createRadialGradient(
      -radius * 0.30, -radius * 0.26, radius * 0.05,
      radius * 0.05, radius * 0.02, radius * 1.08
    );
    capGrad.addColorStop(0, '#965831');
    capGrad.addColorStop(0.28, '#6e3b1d');
    capGrad.addColorStop(0.62, '#42200e');
    capGrad.addColorStop(0.88, '#261107');
    capGrad.addColorStop(1, '#1a0b04');
    g.fillStyle = capGrad;
    g.fillRect(-radius * 1.2, -radius, radius * 2.4, radius * 2);

    // Organic mottled mushroom cap texture & subtle pale outer velum flecks
    for (let i = 0; i < 48; i++) {
      const a = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
      const d = Math.sqrt(rng()) * 0.9;
      const mx = Math.cos(a) * radius * d;
      const my = Math.sin(a) * radius * 0.72 * d;
      const mr = radius * (0.05 + rng() * 0.11);
      g.fillStyle = rng() > 0.45
        ? `rgba(175, 118, 72, ${0.06 + rng() * 0.08})`
        : `rgba(22, 8, 3, ${0.14 + rng() * 0.16})`;
      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(mx, my, mr, mr * 0.7, rng() * Math.PI, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
    }

    // Subtle pale rim flecks typical of dried/simmered shiitake
    for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
      const a = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
      const d = 0.72 + rng() * 0.22;
      const mx = Math.cos(a) * radius * d;
      const my = Math.sin(a) * radius * 0.72 * d;
      g.fillStyle = `rgba(225, 195, 155, ${0.12 + rng() * 0.16})`;
      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(mx, my, radius * 0.04, radius * 0.022, a, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
    }

    // Decorative 6-pointed Kazari-giri star carving (3 intersecting tapered V-cuts!)
    const cutCenterX = -radius * 0.04;
    const cutCenterY = -radius * 0.12;
    const cutAngles = [-0.22, 0.84, 1.90];
    for (let k = 0; k < cutAngles.length; k++) {
      const ang = cutAngles[k] + (seed % 3) * 0.09;
      const len = radius * 0.62;
      const wid = radius * 0.115;

      g.save();
      g.translate(cutCenterX, cutCenterY);
      g.scale(1, 0.75);
      g.rotate(ang);

      // Dark outer rim bevel along skin edge
      g.fillStyle = 'rgba(24, 9, 3, 0.78)';
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(-len * 1.03, 0);
      g.quadraticCurveTo(0, -wid * 1.24, len * 1.03, 0);
      g.quadraticCurveTo(0, wid * 1.24, -len * 1.03, 0);
      g.closePath();
      g.fill();

      // Creamy pale-tan interior mushroom flesh inside the V-cut
      const fleshGrad = g.createLinearGradient(0, -wid, 0, wid);
      fleshGrad.addColorStop(0, '#f0dbb8');
      fleshGrad.addColorStop(0.45, '#dfc092');
      fleshGrad.addColorStop(0.55, '#b68955');
      fleshGrad.addColorStop(1, '#e8cfa6');
      g.fillStyle = fleshGrad;
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(-len, 0);
      g.quadraticCurveTo(0, -wid, len, 0);
      g.quadraticCurveTo(0, wid, -len, 0);
      g.closePath();
      g.fill();

      // Crisp inner V-trough crease shadow
      g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(92, 50, 22, 0.55)';
      g.lineWidth = Math.max(0.8, radius * 0.024);
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(-len * 0.88, 0);
      g.lineTo(len * 0.88, 0);
      g.stroke();

      g.restore();
    }

    // Center star highlight softening where cuts intersect
    const starGlow = g.createRadialGradient(cutCenterX, cutCenterY, 0, cutCenterX, cutCenterY, radius * 0.20);
    starGlow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(246, 228, 196, 0.55)');
    starGlow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(246, 228, 196, 0)');
    g.fillStyle = starGlow;
    g.beginPath();
    g.arc(cutCenterX, cutCenterY, radius * 0.20, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.fill();

    // Glossy tare glaze specular highlights on the wet cap shoulders
    g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 232, 196, 0.26)';
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(-radius * 0.36, -radius * 0.28, radius * 0.22, radius * 0.09, -0.45, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.fill();

    g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 245, 224, 0.58)';
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(-radius * 0.40, -radius * 0.31, radius * 0.08, radius * 0.032, -0.45, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.fill();

    g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 222, 175, 0.16)';
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(radius * 0.34, -radius * 0.18, radius * 0.15, radius * 0.055, 0.35, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.fill();

    g.restore();

    // Subtle warm wet broth meniscus glint hugging the lower submerged cap margin
    g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 208, 126, 0.36)';
    g.lineWidth = Math.max(1.0, radius * 0.025);
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(0, radius * 0.02, radius * 0.96, radius * 0.71, 0, Math.PI * 0.15, Math.PI * 0.85);
    g.stroke();

    return { canvas: c, ox, oy };
  }

  // --- B. Thick Seared Crispy Artisanal Tofu Slab ---
  function buildTofuSprite(wSize, hSize, thickness, seed) {
    const rng = mulberry32(seed);
    const pad = Math.ceil(Math.max(wSize, hSize) * 0.42);
    const cw = Math.ceil(wSize + pad * 2);
    const ch = Math.ceil(hSize + thickness + pad * 2);
    const ox = cw * 0.5;
    const oy = ch * 0.48;
    const c = makeCanvas(cw * dpr, ch * dpr);
    const g = c.getContext('2d');
    g.scale(dpr, dpr);
    g.translate(ox, oy);

    const hw = wSize * 0.5;
    const hh = hSize * 0.5;
    const rad = Math.min(wSize, hSize) * 0.15;

    function roundedRectPath(ctx2, x, y, w, h, r) {
      ctx2.beginPath();
      ctx2.moveTo(x + r, y);
      ctx2.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
      ctx2.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
      ctx2.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
      ctx2.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
      ctx2.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
      ctx2.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
      ctx2.lineTo(x, y + r);
      ctx2.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
      ctx2.closePath();
    }

    // Broth contact shadow
    g.save();
    g.fillStyle = 'rgba(42, 14, 3, 0.48)';
    g.filter = 'blur(4px)';
    roundedRectPath(g, -hw + 2, -hh + thickness * 0.85, wSize + 3, hSize + 3, rad);
    g.fill();
    g.filter = 'none';
    g.restore();

    // 1) Silky creamy tofu side-wall (extruded downward by thickness)
    g.save();
    roundedRectPath(g, -hw, -hh + thickness, wSize, hSize, rad);
    g.clip();
    const sideGrad = g.createLinearGradient(-hw, -hh + thickness, hw, hh + thickness);
    sideGrad.addColorStop(0, '#f3e5c8');
    sideGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#e2ca9e');
    sideGrad.addColorStop(1, '#b89460');
    g.fillStyle = sideGrad;
    g.fillRect(-hw - 2, -hh, wSize + 4, hSize + thickness + 4);

    // Subtle soy-broth soaking gradient along the submerged lower rim of side wall
    const soakGrad = g.createLinearGradient(0, hh - thickness * 0.2, 0, hh + thickness);
    soakGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(185, 102, 24, 0)');
    soakGrad.addColorStop(0.6, 'rgba(165, 82, 16, 0.35)');
    soakGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(110, 44, 8, 0.65)');
    g.fillStyle = soakGrad;
    g.fillRect(-hw, hh - thickness * 0.5, wSize, thickness * 1.8);

    // Delicate tofu micro-pores along side wall
    for (let i = 0; i < 36; i++) {
      const px = -hw + rng() * wSize;
      const py = hh - hSize * 0.1 + rng() * (thickness + hSize * 0.1);
      g.fillStyle = `rgba(145, 108, 66, ${0.12 + rng() * 0.16})`;
      g.beginPath();
      g.arc(px, py, 0.6 + rng() * 1.1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
    }
    g.restore();

    // Connect left & right vertical edges seamlessly
    g.fillStyle = '#e5cfa4';
    g.fillRect(-hw, -hh + rad, rad * 0.5, thickness);
    g.fillStyle = '#bd9862';
    g.fillRect(hw - rad * 0.5, -hh + rad, rad * 0.5, thickness);

    // 2) Seared Golden-Caramelized Top Face
    g.save();
    roundedRectPath(g, -hw, -hh, wSize, hSize, rad);
    g.clip();

    const topGrad = g.createLinearGradient(-hw, -hh, hw, hh);
    topGrad.addColorStop(0, '#e8b360');
    topGrad.addColorStop(0.32, '#cf8433');
    topGrad.addColorStop(0.7, '#a5561c');
    topGrad.addColorStop(1, '#78360e');
    g.fillStyle = topGrad;
    g.fillRect(-hw - 2, -hh - 2, wSize + 4, hSize + 4);

    // Crispy pan-seared crust mottling & toasted amber blisters
    for (let i = 0; i < 95; i++) {
      const px = -hw + rng() * wSize;
      const py = -hh + rng() * hSize;
      const pr = 1.4 + rng() * (wSize * 0.085);
      const isDarkSear = rng() > 0.42;
      g.fillStyle = isDarkSear
        ? `rgba(88, 34, 8, ${0.12 + rng() * 0.22})`
        : `rgba(255, 214, 134, ${0.10 + rng() * 0.16})`;
      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(px, py, pr, pr * (0.55 + rng() * 0.5), rng() * Math.PI, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
    }

    // Subtle appetizing soy-glaze pan sear marks (soft diagonal caramel bands)
    g.save();
    g.rotate(-0.36);
    for (let s = -1; s <= 1; s++) {
      const sy = s * hSize * 0.30;
      const sg = g.createLinearGradient(0, sy - 5, 0, sy + 5);
      sg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(65, 22, 5, 0)');
      sg.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(62, 20, 4, 0.36)');
      sg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(65, 22, 5, 0)');
      g.fillStyle = sg;
      g.fillRect(-wSize, sy - 5, wSize * 2, 10);
    }
    g.restore();

    // Lighter beveled ivory-gold perimeter edge where crust transitions to soft interior
    g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(252, 232, 188, 0.45)';
    g.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, wSize * 0.032);
    roundedRectPath(g, -hw + 1, -hh + 1, wSize - 2, hSize - 2, rad * 0.92);
    g.stroke();

    // Glossy soy-sesame glaze specular sheen on top-left corner
    const glz = g.createRadialGradient(-hw * 0.42, -hh * 0.38, 1, -hw * 0.35, -hh * 0.30, wSize * 0.44);
    glz.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 244, 212, 0.42)');
    glz.addColorStop(0.4, 'rgba(255, 222, 160, 0.14)');
    glz.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 222, 160, 0)');
    g.fillStyle = glz;
    g.fillRect(-hw, -hh, wSize, hSize);

    // Tiny glossy oil-glaze pinpoint sparkles
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      const sx = -hw * 0.65 + rng() * wSize * 0.65;
      const sy = -hh * 0.65 + rng() * hSize * 0.55;
      g.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 250, 235, ${0.35 + rng() * 0.35})`;
      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(sx, sy, 1.5 + rng() * 1.8, 0.9 + rng() * 0.8, -0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
    }
    g.restore();

    // Crisp wet golden broth meniscus along bottom rim
    g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 212, 132, 0.38)';
    g.lineWidth = 1.2;
    g.beginPath();
    g.moveTo(-hw + rad, hh + thickness - 0.5);
    g.lineTo(hw - rad, hh + thickness - 0.5);
    g.stroke();

    return { canvas: c, ox, oy };
  }

  // --- C. Pan-Seared Lotus Root (Renkon) Slice ---
  function buildLotusSprite(radius, seed) {
    const rng = mulberry32(seed);
    const w = Math.ceil(radius * 2.7);
    const h = Math.ceil(radius * 2.3);
    const ox = w * 0.5;
    const oy = h * 0.5;
    const c = makeCanvas(w * dpr, h * dpr);
    const g = c.getContext('2d');
    g.scale(dpr, dpr);
    g.translate(ox, oy);

    // Subtle broth contact shadow
    g.save();
    g.fillStyle = 'rgba(42, 14, 3, 0.42)';
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(radius * 0.06, radius * 0.16, radius * 1.02, radius * 0.74, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.fill();
    g.restore();

    // Scalloped lotus slice path (7 gentle outer lobes)
    function traceLotus(ctx2, scX, scY, offY) {
      const pts = 42;
      ctx2.beginPath();
      for (let i = 0; i <= pts; i++) {
        const a = (i / pts) * Math.PI * 2;
        const scallop = 0.96 + Math.cos(a * 7 + seed) * 0.042;
        const px = Math.cos(a) * radius * scX * scallop;
        const py = Math.sin(a) * radius * scY * scallop + offY;
        if (i === 0) ctx2.moveTo(px, py);
        else ctx2.lineTo(px, py);
      }
      ctx2.closePath();
    }

    const holes = [];
    const holeCount = 7;
    for (let i = 0; i < holeCount; i++) {
      const a = (i / holeCount) * Math.PI * 2 + 0.25 + seed * 0.1;
      const dist = radius * 0.52;
      holes.push({
        x: Math.cos(a) * dist,
        y: Math.sin(a) * dist * 0.72,
        rx: radius * (0.14 + (i % 2) * 0.025),
        ry: radius * (0.11 + (i % 2) * 0.015),
        rot: a
      });
    }
    // Tiny center pore
    holes.push({ x: 0, y: 0, rx: radius * 0.07, ry: radius * 0.055, rot: 0 });

    // Lower bevel thickness (brown caramelized outer skin rim)
    g.save();
    traceLotus(g, 1.0, 0.73, radius * 0.11);
    g.fillStyle = '#8b572a';
    g.fill();
    g.restore();

    // Main top face clipped with radial holes punched cleanly out (or filled with deep broth shadow!)
    g.save();
    traceLotus(g, 1.0, 0.73, 0);
    g.clip();

    const lGrad = g.createRadialGradient(
      -radius * 0.25, -radius * 0.20, radius * 0.05,
      0, 0, radius * 1.05
    );
    lGrad.addColorStop(0, '#f5e4c2');
    lGrad.addColorStop(0.55, '#e2c28d');
    lGrad.addColorStop(0.84, '#c28b49');
    lGrad.addColorStop(1, '#8c5120');
    g.fillStyle = lGrad;
    g.fillRect(-radius * 1.1, -radius, radius * 2.2, radius * 2);

    // Subtle pan-seared golden caramel blush patches
    for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
      const a = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
      const d = 0.2 + rng() * 0.65;
      const sx = Math.cos(a) * radius * d;
      const sy = Math.sin(a) * radius * 0.7 * d;
      const sr = radius * (0.12 + rng() * 0.18);
      const sg = g.createRadialGradient(sx, sy, 0, sx, sy, sr);
      sg.addColorStop(0, `rgba(162, 82, 22, ${0.14 + rng() * 0.16})`);
      sg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(162, 82, 22, 0)');
      g.fillStyle = sg;
      g.beginPath();
      g.arc(sx, sy, sr, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
    }

    // Crisp golden seared outer skin stroke
    g.strokeStyle = '#733e16';
    g.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, radius * 0.06);
    traceLotus(g, 0.99, 0.72, 0);
    g.stroke();

    // Radial air chambers with inner tunnel thickness & dark amber broth visible inside!
    for (let i = 0; i < holes.length; i++) {
      const hl = holes[i];
      // Outer crisp rim highlight
      g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 240, 206, 0.45)';
      g.lineWidth = 1.2;
      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(hl.x, hl.y, hl.rx + 0.8, hl.ry + 0.8, hl.rot, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.stroke();

      // Inner tunnel wall (warm tan shade)
      g.fillStyle = '#9e6834';
      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(hl.x, hl.y, hl.rx, hl.ry, hl.rot, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();

      // Recessed warm broth/shadow peeking through lower interior of hole
      g.save();
      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(hl.x, hl.y, hl.rx, hl.ry, hl.rot, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.clip();
      const holeGrad = g.createRadialGradient(hl.x + 1, hl.y + hl.ry * 0.35, 0.5, hl.x, hl.y + 1, hl.rx * 1.15);
      holeGrad.addColorStop(0, '#9a4710');
      holeGrad.addColorStop(0.55, '#592306');
      holeGrad.addColorStop(1, '#2c1003');
      g.fillStyle = holeGrad;
      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(hl.x + hl.rx * 0.08, hl.y + hl.ry * 0.28, hl.rx * 0.92, hl.ry * 0.86, hl.rot, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
      g.restore();
    }

    // Wet sheen across top-left
    g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 248, 232, 0.22)';
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(-radius * 0.25, -radius * 0.22, radius * 0.38, radius * 0.14, -0.35, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.fill();

    g.restore();

    return { canvas: c, ox, oy };
  }

  // --- D. Charred Baby Bok Choy Cluster (Lush Stalks + Ruffled Veined Emerald Leaves) ---
  function buildBokChoySprite(scaleR) {
    const w = Math.ceil(scaleR * 1.45);
    const h = Math.ceil(scaleR * 1.25);
    const ox = w * 0.42;
    const oy = h * 0.54;

    const g = c.getContext('2d');
    g.scale(dpr, dpr);
    g.translate(ox, oy);

    // Helper: draw one tender bok choy leaf-and-stalk frond
    function drawFrond(angle, len, leafW, stalkW, shadeMult, charTip) {
      g.save();
      g.rotate(angle);

      // Soft contact shadow on broth/leaves beneath
      g.fillStyle = 'rgba(24, 12, 3, 0.34)';
      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(len * 0.46, leafW * 0.22, len * 0.48, leafW * 0.52, 0.06, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();

      // Leaf blade (ruffled organic paddle silhouette)
      function traceLeaf(ctx2) {
        ctx2.beginPath();
        ctx2.moveTo(len * 0.28, -stalkW * 0.42);
        ctx2.bezierCurveTo(
          len * 0.46, -leafW * 0.82,
          len * 0.72, -leafW * 0.96,
          len * 0.88, -leafW * 0.56
        );
        ctx2.bezierCurveTo(
          len * 1.03, -leafW * 0.22,
          len * 1.02, leafW * 0.24,
          len * 0.86, leafW * 0.58
        );
        ctx2.bezierCurveTo(
          len * 0.68, leafW * 0.92,
          len * 0.44, leafW * 0.78,
          len * 0.28, stalkW * 0.42
        );
        ctx2.closePath();
      }

      g.save();
      traceLeaf(g);
      g.clip();

      // Rich emerald-jade leaf blade gradient
      const lg = g.createLinearGradient(len * 0.25, -leafW * 0.7, len * 0.98, leafW * 0.65);
      lg.addColorStop(0, `rgb(${Math.round(92 * shadeMult)}, ${Math.round(145 * shadeMult)}, ${Math.round(74 * shadeMult)})`);
      lg.addColorStop(0.32, `rgb(${Math.round(48 * shadeMult)}, ${Math.round(112 * shadeMult)}, ${Math.round(52 * shadeMult)})`);
      lg.addColorStop(0.72, `rgb(${Math.round(28 * shadeMult)}, ${Math.round(78 * shadeMult)}, ${Math.round(35 * shadeMult)})`);
      lg.addColorStop(1, `rgb(${Math.round(18 * shadeMult)}, ${Math.round(52 * shadeMult)}, ${Math.round(24 * shadeMult)})`);
      g.fillStyle = lg;
      g.fillRect(0, -leafW * 1.1, len * 1.1, leafW * 2.2);

      // Subtle ruffled sunlit leaf folds
      const foldG = g.createRadialGradient(len * 0.64, -leafW * 0.32, 2, len * 0.64, -leafW * 0.32, leafW * 0.75);
      foldG.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(138, 206, 98, 0.36)');
      foldG.addColorStop(0.6, 'rgba(84, 152, 68, 0.08)');
      foldG.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
      g.fillStyle = foldG;
      g.fillRect(0, -leafW, len * 1.1, leafW * 2);

      // Delicate pale-jade branching veins
      g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(195, 226, 152, 0.34)';
      g.lineWidth = Math.max(0.8, scaleR * 0.008);
      for (let v = 0; v < 5; v++) {
        const vx = len * (0.38 + v * 0.11);
        const span = leafW * (0.55 - Math.abs(v - 2) * 0.09);
        g.beginPath();
        g.moveTo(vx, 0);
        g.quadraticCurveTo(vx + len * 0.07, -span * 0.45, vx + len * 0.13, -span * 0.85);
        g.moveTo(vx, 0);
        g.quadraticCurveTo(vx + len * 0.07, span * 0.45, vx + len * 0.13, span * 0.85);
        g.stroke();
      }

      // Appetizing blistered dark wok-char kiss along tip edge
      if (charTip) {
        const cg = g.createRadialGradient(len * 0.94, -leafW * 0.14, 1, len * 0.93, -leafW * 0.12, leafW * 0.42);
        cg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(18, 12, 8, 0.86)');
        cg.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(38, 24, 12, 0.48)');
        cg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(38, 24, 12, 0)');
        g.fillStyle = cg;
        g.beginPath();
        g.arc(len * 0.94, -leafW * 0.14, leafW * 0.42, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        g.fill();
      }

      // Glossy broth sheen streaks on wet leaf
      g.fillStyle = 'rgba(242, 255, 224, 0.24)';
      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(len * 0.62, -leafW * 0.36, len * 0.14, leafW * 0.12, -0.25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
      g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 252, 232, 0.46)';
      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(len * 0.59, -leafW * 0.38, len * 0.05, leafW * 0.04, -0.25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
      g.restore();

      // Succulent pale-celadon cupped stalk & tapering midrib
      g.save();
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(-len * 0.08, -stalkW * 0.32);
      g.quadraticCurveTo(len * 0.18, -stalkW * 0.72, len * 0.56, -stalkW * 0.26);
      g.quadraticCurveTo(len * 0.74, -stalkW * 0.06, len * 0.84, 0);
      g.quadraticCurveTo(len * 0.74, stalkW * 0.08, len * 0.56, stalkW * 0.26);
      g.quadraticCurveTo(len * 0.18, stalkW * 0.72, -len * 0.08, stalkW * 0.32);
      g.quadraticCurveTo(-len * 0.16, 0, -len * 0.08, -stalkW * 0.32);
      g.closePath();

      const stGrad = g.createLinearGradient(0, -stalkW * 0.7, 0, stalkW * 0.7);
      stGrad.addColorStop(0, '#eef3db');
      stGrad.addColorStop(0.35, '#d5e4b4');
      stGrad.addColorStop(0.75, '#9ec076');
      stGrad.addColorStop(1, '#6f914e');
      g.fillStyle = stGrad;
      g.fill();

      // Subtle glossy highlight along stalk ridge
      g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 254, 240, 0.55)';
      g.lineWidth = Math.max(1.2, stalkW * 0.14);
      g.lineCap = 'round';
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(len * 0.04, -stalkW * 0.22);
      g.quadraticCurveTo(len * 0.28, -stalkW * 0.28, len * 0.54, -stalkW * 0.08);
      g.stroke();

      // Tiny caramelized sear kiss on stalk shoulder
      if (charTip) {
        g.fillStyle = 'rgba(72, 34, 10, 0.32)';
        g.beginPath();
        g.ellipse(len * 0.24, stalkW * 0.15, len * 0.08, stalkW * 0.18, 0.1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        g.fill();
      }
      g.restore();

      g.restore();
    }

    // Compose a luscious halved baby bok choy fan (back shadowed leaves -> front vibrant leaves -> central heart)
    drawFrond(-0.62, scaleR * 0.68, scaleR * 0.22, scaleR * 0.11, 0.82, true);
    drawFrond(0.34, scaleR * 0.64, scaleR * 0.21, scaleR * 0.11, 0.86, false);
    drawFrond(-0.24, scaleR * 0.78, scaleR * 0.25, scaleR * 0.13, 1.0, true);
    drawFrond(0.08, scaleR * 0.72, scaleR * 0.23, scaleR * 0.125, 1.06, false);
    // Tender inner baby heart leaf
    drawFrond(-0.08, scaleR * 0.46, scaleR * 0.13, scaleR * 0.095, 1.18, false);

    // Bulbous sliced stem base nestled in the broth
    const baseG = g.createRadialGradient(-scaleR * 0.04, -scaleR * 0.02, 1, 0, 0, scaleR * 0.20);
    baseG.addColorStop(0, '#f3f5e2');
    baseG.addColorStop(0.55, '#cfe0aa');
    baseG.addColorStop(1, '#84a55f');
    g.fillStyle = baseG;
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(-scaleR * 0.04, 0, scaleR * 0.16, scaleR * 0.18, -0.1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.fill();

    // Crescent stalk-layer lines on the cut stem base
    g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(104, 134, 72, 0.45)';
    g.lineWidth = 1.1;
    for (let r = 0.05; r <= 0.12; r += 0.035) {
      g.beginPath();
      g.arc(-scaleR * 0.04, 0, scaleR * r, -1.2, 1.2);
      g.stroke();
    }

    return { canvas: c, ox, oy };
  }

  // --- E. Crisp Toasted Nori Seaweed Sheet ---
  function buildNoriSprite(wSize, hSize, seed) {
    const rng = mulberry32(seed);
    const pad = Math.ceil(Math.max(wSize, hSize) * 0.22);
    const cw = Math.ceil(wSize + pad * 2);
    const ch = Math.ceil(hSize + pad * 2);
    const ox = cw * 0.5;
    const oy = ch - pad; // pivot at bottom-center where it tucks into the broth!
    const c = makeCanvas(cw * dpr, ch * dpr);
    const g = c.getContext('2d');
    g.scale(dpr, dpr);
    g.translate(ox, oy);

    // Subtle organic slightly curved trapezoidal sheet (slightly wider at top, faint heat curl)
    const bw = wSize * 0.46;
    const tw = wSize * 0.52;
    const curl = (seed % 2 === 0 ? 1 : -1) * wSize * 0.04;

    function traceNori(ctx2) {
      ctx2.beginPath();
      ctx2.moveTo(-bw, 0);
      ctx2.quadraticCurveTo(-bw - curl * 0.5, -hSize * 0.52, -tw + curl, -hSize);
      ctx2.quadraticCurveTo(0, -hSize - hSize * 0.03, tw + curl, -hSize + hSize * 0.02);
      ctx2.quadraticCurveTo(bw + curl * 0.4, -hSize * 0.48, bw, 0);
      ctx2.closePath();
    }

    // Soft cast shadow behind sheet
    g.save();
    g.translate(4, 3);
    g.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.46)';
    traceNori(g);
    g.fill();
    g.restore();

    g.save();
    traceNori(g);
    g.clip();

    // Base roasted seaweed deep charcoal-emerald gradient
    const ng = g.createLinearGradient(-tw, -hSize, tw, 0);
    ng.addColorStop(0, '#223121');
    ng.addColorStop(0.35, '#152015');
    ng.addColorStop(0.7, '#0e160f');
    ng.addColorStop(1, '#090e0a');
    g.fillStyle = ng;
    g.fillRect(-tw - 14, -hSize - 14, tw * 2 + 28, hSize + 28);

    // Pressed crispy fibrous seaweed micro-texture (hundreds of tiny organic strands)
    for (let i = 0; i < 420; i++) {
      const fx = (rng() * 2 - 1) * tw * 1.1;
      const fy = -rng() * hSize * 1.04;
      const fl = 3 + rng() * (wSize * 0.14);
      const fa = rng() * Math.PI;
      const isHighlight = rng() > 0.58;
      g.strokeStyle = isHighlight
        ? `rgba(74, 112, 66, ${0.14 + rng() * 0.22})`
        : `rgba(5, 9, 6, ${0.32 + rng() * 0.35})`;
      g.lineWidth = 0.6 + rng() * 1.0;
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(fx, fy);
      g.lineTo(fx + Math.cos(fa) * fl, fy + Math.sin(fa) * fl);
      g.stroke();
    }

    // Tiny subtle backlit translucent emerald pinholes near the upper thin part
    for (let i = 0; i < 28; i++) {
      const px = (rng() * 2 - 1) * tw * 0.85;
      const py = -hSize * (0.45 + rng() * 0.50);
      g.fillStyle = `rgba(128, 168, 92, ${0.14 + rng() * 0.18})`;
      g.fillRect(px, py, 1.3, 1.0);
    }

    // Warm overhead light sheen catching the crispy upper-left surface
    const sheen = g.createLinearGradient(-tw, -hSize, tw * 0.6, -hSize * 0.2);
    sheen.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(220, 212, 165, 0.18)');
    sheen.addColorStop(0.45, 'rgba(155, 175, 128, 0.06)');
    sheen.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
    g.fillStyle = sheen;
    g.fillRect(-tw - 10, -hSize - 10, tw * 2 + 20, hSize + 20);

    // Slick darker moisture-soaked band along bottom edge dipping into hot broth
    const wetBand = g.createLinearGradient(0, -hSize * 0.26, 0, 0);
    wetBand.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(10, 12, 8, 0)');
    wetBand.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(12, 10, 6, 0.52)');
    wetBand.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(42, 20, 6, 0.82)');
    g.fillStyle = wetBand;
    g.fillRect(-tw - 10, -hSize * 0.28, tw * 2 + 20, hSize * 0.32);

    g.restore();

    // Subtle crisp toasted top edge highlight
    g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(155, 175, 132, 0.24)';
    g.lineWidth = 1.0;
    g.beginPath();
    g.moveTo(-tw + curl, -hSize);
    g.quadraticCurveTo(0, -hSize - hSize * 0.03, tw + curl, -hSize + hSize * 0.02);
    g.stroke();

    return { canvas: c, ox, oy };
  }

  // =========================================================================

  function initSceneData() {
    const rng = mulberry32(20260401);

    // --- Folded Wavy Alkaline Ramen Noodles (Chijire-men) ---
    // Normalized broth coordinates (bx, by in [-1, 1])
    noodles = [];
    const strandCount = 30;
    for (let i = 0; i < strandCount; i++) {
      const f = i / (strandCount - 1); // 0..1 across fold width
      const spread = (f - 0.5) * 2;    // -1..1
      const phase = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
      const crinkleFreq = 9.5 + rng() * 3.8;
      const crinkleAmp = 0.016 + rng() * 0.012;
      // Emergent height profile: middle strands arch highest above the broth
      const crestBoost = 1 - Math.abs(spread) * 0.55;
      const widthScale = 0.86 + rng() * 0.28;
      const shadeShift = (rng() - 0.5) * 14;
      noodles.push({
        spread,
        phase,
        crinkleFreq,
        crinkleAmp,
        crestBoost,
        widthScale,
        shadeShift,
        // Gentle lateral offset variation for natural hand-folded look
        startOff: (rng() - 0.5) * 0.08,
        endOff: (rng() - 0.5) * 0.08

    }

    cornKernels = [];

      const by = cornCenter.y + Math.sin(a) * 0.22 * d;

      cornKernels.push({

        rot: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
        size: 0.036 + rng() * 0.016,

    }
    cornKernels.sort((a, b) => a.by - b.by);

    // --- Fresh Finely-Sliced Scallion Rings (Negi) ---
    scallions = [];
    const scallionSpots = [
      // Center crown cluster
      [-0.08, 0.12], [0.04, 0.06], [0.11, 0.17], [-0.02, 0.22],
      [0.08, -0.02], [-0.14, 0.03], [0.16, 0.08], [-0.04, -0.08],
      // Floating organically across open broth pockets
      [0.24, 0.24], [-0.26, 0.52], [0.02, 0.58], [0.48, 0.28],
      [-0.12, -0.26], [0.22, -0.24], [-0.32, -0.02], [0.14, 0.38]
    ];
    for (let i = 0; i < scallionSpots.length; i++) {

  // =========================================================================
  // 7. Fluid Curl-Noise Steam System (Dual-Layer: Plumes + Silk Tendril Ribbons)
  // =========================================================================
  function spawnSteamPuff(rng, prewarmFrac) {
    // Emit organically across hot broth surface (strongest near warm center)
    const ang = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
    const rad = Math.pow(rng(), 0.72) * 0.74;
    const ex = Math.cos(ang) * L.brothRx * rad;
    const ey = L.brothOffY + Math.sin(ang) * L.brothRy * rad * 0.85;
    const maxLife = 3.6 + rng() * 3.4;
    return {
      x: ex,
      y: ey,
      vx: (rng() - 0.5) * 8,
      vy: -(22 + rng() * 20) * (L.R / 210),
      age: prewarmFrac * maxLife,
      maxLife,
      baseSize: (0.14 + rng() * 0.22) * L.R,
      rot: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
      rotSpd: (rng() - 0.5) * 0.45,
      brush: (rng() * 3) | 0,
      seed: rng() * 100,
      alphaMax: 0.13 + rng() * 0.11
    };
  }

  function initSteamSystem() {
    const rng = mulberry32(55109);
    steamPuffs = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
      steamPuffs.push(spawnSteamPuff(rng, rng()));
    }

    // 13 continuous silky vapor ribbons rising from warm hot-spots across the broth
    steamRibbons = [];
    const ribbonCount = 13;
    const segs = 26;
    for (let i = 0; i < ribbonCount; i++) {
      const f = i / (ribbonCount - 1);
      const baseAngle = (f - 0.5) * Math.PI * 1.15 + (rng() - 0.5) * 0.22;
      const baseRad = (0.08 + rng() * 0.56);
      const bx = Math.sin(baseAngle) * L.brothRx * baseRad;
      const by = L.brothOffY + (rng() - 0.42) * L.brothRy * 0.75;
      const pts = [];
      for (let s = 0; s < segs; s++) {
        pts.push({ x: bx, y: by - s * 4, vx: 0, vy: 0 });
      }
      steamRibbons.push({
        baseX: bx,
        baseY: by,
        pts,
        riseSpeed: (0.46 + rng() * 0.28) * (L.R / 190),
        widthBase: (0.045 + rng() * 0.055) * L.R,
        alpha: 0.075 + rng() * 0.065,
        phase: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
        noiseOff: rng() * 40,
        heightFactor: 0.85 + rng() * 0.55
      });
    }

    // Pre-warm steam simulation so frame 1 is already luxuriously steaming!
    const preSteps = 210;
    const fixedDt = 1 / 60;
    for (let k = 0; k < preSteps; k++) {
      stepSteam(fixedDt, k * fixedDt, true);
    }
  }

  function sampleWakeForce(px, py) {
    let fx = 0;
    let fy = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < wakes.length; i++) {
      const wk = wakes[i];
      const dx = px - wk.x;
      const dy = py - wk.y;
      const distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy;
      const rSq = wk.r * wk.r;
      if (distSq < rSq * 2.8) {
        const falloff = Math.exp(-distSq / (rSq * 0.75)) * wk.strength;
        // Direct air push + gentle curl eddy perpendicular to wake velocity
        fx += wk.vx * falloff * 0.85;
        fy += wk.vy * falloff * 0.85;
        // Subtle outward parting / vortex curl
        const dist = Math.sqrt(distSq) + 1;
        const swirl = (wk.vx * dy - wk.vy * dx) / (dist * wk.r);
        fx += (-dy / dist) * swirl * falloff * 28;
        fy += (dx / dist) * swirl * falloff * 28;
      }
    }
    return { fx, fy };
  }

  const liveSteamRng = mulberry32(88421);

  function stepSteam(dt, timeSec, isPrewarm) {
    const scale = L.R / 210;
    const warmthMult = 1 + ptr.warmthBoost * 0.35;

    // 1) Advect soft volumetric puffs
    for (let i = 0; i < steamPuffs.length; i++) {
      const p = steamPuffs[i];
      p.age += dt;
      if (p.age >= p.maxLife) {
        const fresh = spawnSteamPuff(liveSteamRng, 0);
        steamPuffs[i] = fresh;
        continue;
      }

      const lifeT = p.age / p.maxLife;
      const nx = p.x / (L.R * 0.92);
      const ny = p.y / (L.R * 0.92);
      const c = curlNoise(nx * 1.15 + p.seed * 0.03, ny * 1.15 - timeSec * 0.24, timeSec);

      // Natural upward buoyancy with gentle lateral widening as it rises
      const targetVx = c.vx * 26 * scale + Math.sin(timeSec * 0.45 + p.seed) * 6 * scale;
      const targetVy = -(26 + 22 * (1 - lifeT * 0.45)) * scale * warmthMult + c.vy * 14 * scale;

      p.vx = lerp(p.vx, targetVx, Math.min(1, dt * 2.2));
      p.vy = lerp(p.vy, targetVy, Math.min(1, dt * 2.2));

      if (!isPrewarm && wakes.length > 0) {
        const wf = sampleWakeForce(p.x, p.y);
        p.vx += wf.fx * dt * 4.2;
        p.vy += wf.fy * dt * 4.2;
      }

      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      p.rot += p.rotSpd * dt;
    }

    // 2) Advect continuous silk tendril ribbons (chain advection from broth upward)
    const segStep = (L.R * 0.072);
    for (let r = 0; r < steamRibbons.length; r++) {
      const rb = steamRibbons[r];
      const pts = rb.pts;
      // Anchor point gently meanders across its warm broth emitter spot
      pts[0].x = rb.baseX + Math.sin(timeSec * 0.62 + rb.phase) * L.R * 0.055;
      pts[0].y = rb.baseY + Math.cos(timeSec * 0.48 + rb.phase * 1.3) * L.R * 0.025;

      // Advect upper spine points continuously upward with fluid curl & mouse wake
      for (let s = pts.length - 1; s >= 1; s--) {
        const prev = pts[s - 1];
        const curr = pts[s];
        const frac = s / (pts.length - 1);

        // Smoothly propagate lower geometry upward
        const pull = Math.min(1, dt * 7.8 * rb.riseSpeed);
        const riseDy = segStep * rb.heightFactor * (0.78 + frac * 0.55) * warmthMult;
        let tx = prev.x;
        let ty = prev.y - riseDy;

        // Add organic fluid curl turbulence growing with height
        const c = curlNoise(
          curr.x / (L.R * 0.78) + rb.noiseOff * 0.05,
          curr.y / (L.R * 0.78) - timeSec * 0.30,
          timeSec
        );
        const swirlGain = (10 + frac * 34) * scale;
        tx += c.vx * swirlGain * dt * 3.8 + Math.sin(timeSec * 0.9 - s * 0.35 + rb.phase) * frac * L.R * 0.015;
        ty += c.vy * swirlGain * dt * 1.4;

        // Apply interactive mouse air wake
        if (!isPrewarm && wakes.length > 0) {
          const wf = sampleWakeForce(curr.x, curr.y);
          curr.vx = lerp(curr.vx, wf.fx * (0.4 + frac * 0.9), Math.min(1, dt * 8));
          curr.vy = lerp(curr.vy, wf.fy * (0.4 + frac * 0.9), Math.min(1, dt * 8));
        } else {
          curr.vx *= Math.pow(0.15, dt);
          curr.vy *= Math.pow(0.15, dt);
        }

        curr.x = lerp(curr.x, tx, pull) + curr.vx * dt * 0.65;
        curr.y = lerp(curr.y, ty, pull) + curr.vy * dt * 0.65;
      }
    }
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 8. Layout & Resize Management
  // =========================================================================
  function updateLayout() {
    W = window.innerWidth;
    H = window.innerHeight;
    dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);

    canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(W * dpr));
    canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(H * dpr));

    // Responsive bowl sizing across desktop, tablet, ultrawide, and portrait mobile
    const aspect = W / Math.max(1, H);
    let r;
    if (aspect < 0.85) {
      // Portrait mobile / tall tablet
      r = Math.min(W * 0.405, H * 0.245);
    } else if (aspect > 2.0) {
      // Ultrawide / short banner
      r = Math.min(W * 0.24, H * 0.355);
    } else {
      // Standard desktop & landscape tablet
      r = Math.min(W * 0.30, H * 0.355);
    }
    r = clamp(r, 95, 340);

    L.R = r;
    L.cx = W * 0.5;
    // Place bowl slightly below vertical center so curling steam gets majestic room above
    L.cy = aspect < 0.85 ? H * 0.60 : H * 0.59;
    L.ryRatio = 0.585;
    L.rimRx = r;
    L.rimRy = r * L.ryRatio;
    L.innerRx = r * 0.936;
    L.innerRy = L.rimRy * 0.936;
    L.innerOffY = r * 0.015;
    L.brothOffY = r * 0.088;
    L.brothRx = r * 0.902;
    L.brothRy = L.rimRy * 0.902;
    L.bowlDepth = r * 0.84;

    if (cache.steamBrushes.length === 0) {
      buildSteamBrushes();
    }

    buildBackdropCache();

    // Rebuild bowl & ingredient caches if radius changed meaningfully
    if (Math.abs(cache.builtR - L.R) > 2 || !cache.bowlBack) {
      buildBowlCaches();
      buildBrothBaseCache();
      buildIngredientCaches();
      cache.builtR = L.R;
    }
    cache.builtW = W;
    cache.builtH = H;

    if (noodles.length === 0) {
      initSceneData();
    }
    initSteamSystem();

    if (reducedMotion) {
      renderFrame(0);
    }
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 9. Drawing Routines

  // Helper: convert normalized broth coords (bx, by) to pixel coords relative to bowl center
  function brothToLocal(bx, by) {
    return {
      x: bx * L.brothRx,
      y: L.brothOffY + by * L.brothRy
    };
  }

  // Draw submerged & emergent folded wavy ramen noodles
  function drawNoodles(g, timeSec, pass) {
    // pass === 'submerged' draws deeper strands softly veiled by amber broth
    // pass === 'emergent' draws rich glistening strands arching above the broth
    const R = L.R;
    const baseThick = Math.max(2.6, R * 0.0235);
    const steps = 26;

    // Master S-curve fold across center-front / lower-left
    function spinePoint(t) {
      // t in [0, 1]
      const x = lerp(-0.52, 0.32, t) + Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * 0.06;
      const y = 0.56 - Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * 0.54 + Math.sin(t * Math.PI * 2) * 0.05;
      return { x, y };
    }

    function spineNormal(t) {
      const e = 0.01;
      const p0 = spinePoint(Math.max(0, t - e));
      const p1 = spinePoint(Math.min(1, t + e));
      const dx = p1.x - p0.x;
      const dy = p1.y - p0.y;
      const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
      return { nx: -dy / len, ny: dx / len };
    }

    g.lineCap = 'round';
    g.lineJoin = 'round';

    for (let i = 0; i < noodles.length; i++) {
      const nd = noodles[i];
      const isUpperBand = nd.crestBoost > 0.52;
      if (pass === 'submerged' && isUpperBand && i % 2 === 0) {
        // Still draw submerged under-glow beneath everything for lush volume
      }

      const pts = [];
      for (let s = 0; s <= steps; s++) {
        const t = s / steps;
        const sp = spinePoint(t);
        const nm = spineNormal(t);

        // Bundle fan width tapers slightly at ends as strands tuck under broth
        const pinch = 0.72 + Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * 0.34;
        const lateral = nd.spread * 0.25 * pinch + lerp(nd.startOff, nd.endOff, t);

        // Wavy alkaline crinkle + gentle live thermal breathing
        const breathe = reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.sin(timeSec * 0.85 + nd.phase + t * 3.0) * 0.004;
        const crinkle = Math.sin(t * nd.crinkleFreq + nd.phase) * nd.crinkleAmp + breathe;

        const bx = sp.x + nm.nx * (lateral + crinkle);
        const by = sp.y + nm.ny * (lateral + crinkle);

        // Height above broth surface: arches above broth in the mid-section of the fold
        const arch = Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * nd.crestBoost - 0.24;
        const loc = brothToLocal(bx, by);
        // Slightly lift emergent peak visually in Y
        const liftY = Math.max(0, arch) * R * 0.055;
        pts.push({ x: loc.x, y: loc.y - liftY, h: arch });
      }

      if (pass === 'submerged') {
        // Draw soft golden-amber submerged volume beneath the broth surface
        g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(222, 152, 62, 0.26)';
        g.lineWidth = baseThick * nd.widthScale * 1.15;
        g.beginPath();
        for (let s = 0; s <= steps; s++) {
          if (s === 0) g.moveTo(pts[s].x, pts[s].y + 2);
          else g.lineTo(pts[s].x, pts[s].y + 2);
        }
        g.stroke();
        continue;
      }

      // --- Emergent pass: only draw segments rising near/above the broth surface ---
      // Find contiguous emerged segment range
      let sStart = -1;
      let sEnd = -1;
      for (let s = 0; s <= steps; s++) {
        if (pts[s].h > -0.02) {
          if (sStart === -1) sStart = s;
          sEnd = s;
        }
      }
      if (sStart === -1 || sEnd - sStart < 2) continue;

      const w = baseThick * nd.widthScale;

      function traceSubPath(offX, offY) {
        g.beginPath();
        for (let s = sStart; s <= sEnd; s++) {
          const p = pts[s];
          if (s === sStart) g.moveTo(p.x + offX, p.y + offY);
          else g.lineTo(p.x + offX, p.y + offY);
        }
      }

      // 1) Soft warm umber inter-strand shadow
      g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(72, 28, 6, 0.52)';
      g.lineWidth = w * 1.22;
      traceSubPath(w * 0.22, w * 0.36);
      g.stroke();

      // 2) Springy golden-wheat noodle body gradient along arc
      const pFirst = pts[sStart];
      const pMid = pts[(sStart + sEnd) >> 1];
      const pLast = pts[sEnd];
      const bodyGrad = g.createLinearGradient(pFirst.x, pFirst.y, pLast.x, pLast.y);
      const rShift = nd.shadeShift;
      bodyGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(182, 108, 32, 0.35)');
      bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.18, `rgb(${clamp(228 + rShift, 190, 250)}, ${clamp(178 + rShift * 0.7, 145, 212)}, 96)`);
      bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.50, `rgb(${clamp(246 + rShift * 0.5, 218, 255)}, ${clamp(210 + rShift * 0.5, 182, 234)}, 134)`);
      bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.82, `rgb(${clamp(218 + rShift, 180, 240)}, ${clamp(164 + rShift * 0.7, 132, 195)}, 82)`);
      bodyGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(168, 92, 24, 0.30)');
      g.strokeStyle = bodyGrad;
      g.lineWidth = w;
      traceSubPath(0, 0);
      g.stroke();

      // 3) Glossy wet broth specular ridge along top-left edge of noodle crest
      const specGrad = g.createLinearGradient(pFirst.x, pFirst.y, pLast.x, pLast.y);
      specGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 250, 232, 0)');
      specGrad.addColorStop(0.28, 'rgba(255, 246, 218, 0.42)');
      specGrad.addColorStop(0.50, 'rgba(255, 252, 238, 0.68)');
      specGrad.addColorStop(0.75, 'rgba(255, 242, 206, 0.25)');
      specGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 240, 200, 0)');
      g.strokeStyle = specGrad;
      g.lineWidth = Math.max(1.0, w * 0.32);
      traceSubPath(-w * 0.14, -w * 0.18);
      g.stroke();

      // Subtle golden meniscus touch at highest peak
      if (i % 5 === 0 && pMid.h > 0.22) {
        g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 252, 240, 0.52)';
        g.beginPath();
        g.ellipse(pMid.x - w * 0.1, pMid.y - w * 0.16, w * 0.38, w * 0.18, -0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        g.fill();
      }
    }
  }

  // Draw Black Garlic Oil (Mayu) pools & Scarlet Chili Oil (Rayu) droplets on broth surface
  function drawOilDroplets(g, timeSec, lightOffX, lightOffY) {
    const R = L.R;

    // 1) Glossy Black Garlic Oil (Mayu) organic swirls
    for (let i = 0; i < mayuPools.length; i++) {
      const m = mayuPools[i];
      const wobbleX = reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.sin(timeSec * 0.45 + m.phase) * 0.008;
      const wobbleY = reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.cos(timeSec * 0.38 + m.phase) * 0.006;
      const pos = brothToLocal(m.bx + wobbleX, m.by + wobbleY);
      const rx = m.rx * L.brothRx;
      const ry = m.ry * L.brothRx;

      g.save();
      g.translate(pos.x, pos.y);
      g.rotate(m.rot);

      // Warm translucent amber edge rim
      g.fillStyle = 'rgba(72, 28, 6, 0.42)';
      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(0, 0, rx * 1.12, ry * 1.12, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();

      // Deep roasted black-garlic oil core
      const mg = g.createRadialGradient(-rx * 0.15, -ry * 0.2, 1, 0, 0, rx);
      mg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(34, 18, 10, 0.88)');
      mg.addColorStop(0.65, 'rgba(18, 10, 6, 0.84)');
      mg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(28, 14, 6, 0.15)');
      g.fillStyle = mg;
      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(0, 0, rx, ry, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();

      // Glossy specular sheen shifting slightly with light
      g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 232, 195, 0.36)';
      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(-rx * 0.28 + lightOffX * 2.5, -ry * 0.28 + lightOffY * 1.6, rx * 0.30, ry * 0.22, -0.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();

      g.restore();
    }

    // 2) Translucent Scarlet-Orange Chili Oil (Rayu) Droplets
    for (let i = 0; i < rayuDroplets.length; i++) {
      const d = rayuDroplets[i];
      const driftX = reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.cos(timeSec * d.driftSpd + d.phase) * d.driftAmp;
      const driftY = reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.sin(timeSec * d.driftSpd * 0.85 + d.phase) * d.driftAmp;
      const pos = brothToLocal(d.bx + driftX + d.dx, d.by + driftY + d.dy);
      const rx = d.r * L.brothRx;
      const ry = rx * L.ryRatio * 1.06;

      // Subtle dark refracted rim
      g.fillStyle = 'rgba(128, 22, 4, 0.56)';
      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(pos.x + 0.5, pos.y + 0.7, rx * 1.08, ry * 1.08, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();

      // Luminous fiery ruby-orange interior
      const rg = g.createRadialGradient(
        pos.x + rx * 0.18, pos.y + ry * 0.22, rx * 0.08,
        pos.x, pos.y, rx * 1.05

      if (d.hueShift > 0.35) {

  // Draw Volumetric Curling Steam (Plumes + Silk Tendril Ribbons)
  function drawSteam(g, lightShiftX) {
    const R = L.R;
    const beamCenterX = lightShiftX * R * 0.25;

    g.save();
    g.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';

    // Layer A: Soft Volumetric Billowing Vapor Plumes
    for (let i = 0; i < steamPuffs.length; i++) {
      const p = steamPuffs[i];
      const lifeT = clamp(p.age / p.maxLife, 0, 1);
      // Graceful fade-in near broth, long translucent bloom, velvety dissolution above
      const env = smoothstep(0, 0.16, lifeT) * (1 - smoothstep(0.42, 1.0, lifeT));
      if (env <= 0.002) continue;

      // Backlit intensity: brighter inside the warm overhead spotlight beam!
      const beamDist = Math.abs(p.x - beamCenterX) / (R * 1.15);
      const beamBoost = 0.55 + 0.65 * Math.exp(-beamDist * beamDist * 1.4);
      const alpha = p.alphaMax * env * beamBoost * (1 + ptr.warmthBoost * 0.28);

      const size = p.baseSize * (0.65 + lifeT * 1.65);
      const stretchY = 1.15 + (1 - lifeT) * 0.42;
      const tilt = clamp(p.vx * 0.008, -0.45, 0.45);

      g.save();
      g.translate(p.x, p.y);
      g.rotate(tilt + p.rot * 0.18);
      g.scale(1.0, stretchY);
      g.globalAlpha = clamp(alpha, 0, 0.42);
      const brush = cache.steamBrushes[p.brush];
      g.drawImage(brush, -size * 0.5, -size * 0.5, size, size);
      g.restore();
    }

    // Layer B: Silky Photographic Curling Vapor Tendril Ribbons
    for (let r = 0; r < steamRibbons.length; r++) {
      const rb = steamRibbons[r];
      const pts = rb.pts;
      if (pts.length < 4) continue;

      // Two-pass soft ribbon: wide feathery vapor veil + delicate luminous silk core
      for (let pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {
        const isCore = pass === 1;
        for (let s = 1; s < pts.length - 1; s++) {
          const frac = s / (pts.length - 1);
          const env = smoothstep(0.0, 0.18, frac) * (1 - smoothstep(0.35, 1.0, frac));
          if (env <= 0.004) continue;

          const pPrev = pts[s - 1];
          const pCurr = pts[s];
          const pNext = pts[s + 1];

          const mx0 = (pPrev.x + pCurr.x) * 0.5;
          const my0 = (pPrev.y + pCurr.y) * 0.5;
          const mx1 = (pCurr.x + pNext.x) * 0.5;
          const my1 = (pCurr.y + pNext.y) * 0.5;

          const beamDist = Math.abs(pCurr.x - beamCenterX) / (R * 1.05);
          const beamLit = 0.52 + 0.68 * Math.exp(-beamDist * beamDist * 1.6);

          const w = rb.widthBase * (0.45 + frac * 1.75) * (isCore ? 0.36 : 1.0);
          const a = rb.alpha * env * beamLit * (isCore ? 0.82 : 0.46) * (1 + ptr.warmthBoost * 0.28);

          // Warm amber-cream near the hot broth, cooling subtly into pale pearl vapor aloft
          const red = 255;
          const grn = Math.round(lerp(226, 240, frac));
          const blu = Math.round(lerp(182, 234, frac));

          g.strokeStyle = `rgba(${red}, ${grn}, ${blu}, ${clamp(a, 0, 0.28)})`;
          g.lineWidth = w;
          g.lineCap = 'round';
          g.beginPath();
          g.moveTo(mx0, my0);
          g.quadraticCurveTo(pCurr.x, pCurr.y, mx1, my1);
          g.stroke();
        }
      }
    }

    g.restore();
  }

  // Draw Subtle Overhead Warm Pendant Light Shaft & Floating Bokeh Dust Motes
  function drawOverheadLightAndMotes(g, timeSec, lightShiftX) {
    const R = L.R;

    const lampX = L.cx - R * 0.14 + sway + lightShiftX * R * 0.22;

    cone.addColorStop(0.85, 'rgba(215, 126, 48, 0.02)');
