    g.beginPath();
    g.moveTo(lampX - R * 0.42, lampTopY);
    g.lineTo(lampX + R * 0.42, lampTopY);
    g.lineTo(L.cx + R * 1.48, L.cy + R * 0.55);
    g.lineTo(L.cx - R * 1.48, L.cy + R * 0.55);
    g.closePath();
    g.fill();

    // Warm intimate ambient glow radiating directly above the hot broth
    const brothAura = g.createRadialGradient(
      L.cx - R * 0.05, L.cy - R * 0.15, R * 0.12,
      L.cx, L.cy - R * 0.10, R * 1.55
    );
    const boost = 1 + ptr.warmthBoost * 0.25;
    brothAura.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 178, 86, ${0.095 * boost})`);
    brothAura.addColorStop(0.45, `rgba(218, 118, 42, ${0.038 * boost})`);
    brothAura.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
    g.fillStyle = brothAura;
    g.beginPath();
    g.arc(L.cx, L.cy - R * 0.10, R * 1.55, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.fill();

    // Floating warm bokeh dust motes drifting lazily in the light shaft
    for (let i = 0; i < motes.length; i++) {
      const m = motes[i];
      const mx = L.cx + m.nx * R * 1.15 - ptr.nx * 10;
      const my = L.cy + m.ny * R * 0.85 - ptr.ny * 8;
      if (my < -20 || my > H + 20) continue;

      const beamDist = Math.abs(mx - (L.cx + lightShiftX * R * 0.2)) / (R * 1.2);
      const twinkle = reducedMotion ? 0.8 : (0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(timeSec * 1.4 + m.phase));
      const a = m.alpha * twinkle * Math.exp(-beamDist * beamDist * 1.2) * smoothstep(0, H * 0.25, my);
      if (a <= 0.01) continue;

      const mg = g.createRadialGradient(mx, my, 0, mx, my, m.r * 2.4);
      mg.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 224, 168, ${a})`);
      mg.addColorStop(0.45, `rgba(255, 188, 112, ${a * 0.35})`);
      mg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 188, 112, 0)');
      g.fillStyle = mg;
      g.beginPath();
      g.arc(mx, my, m.r * 2.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
    }

    g.restore();
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 10. Main Frame Update & Composite Render
  // =========================================================================
  function stepSimulation(dt) {
    elapsed += dt;

    // Smoothly damp pointer parallax & overhead light response
    const damp = Math.min(1, dt * 4.5);
    if (ptr.active) {
      const targetNx = clamp((ptr.rawX - L.cx) / (W * 0.5), -1, 1);
      const targetNy = clamp((ptr.rawY - L.cy) / (H * 0.5), -1, 1);
      ptr.nx = lerp(ptr.nx, targetNx, damp);
      ptr.ny = lerp(ptr.ny, targetNy, damp);
    } else {
      ptr.nx = lerp(ptr.nx, 0, Math.min(1, dt * 1.5));
      ptr.ny = lerp(ptr.ny, 0, Math.min(1, dt * 1.5));
    }

    ptr.warmthBoost = lerp(ptr.warmthBoost, ptr.overBroth ? 1 : 0, Math.min(1, dt * 3.0));

    // Decay air wakes
    for (let i = wakes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      wakes[i].age += dt;
      wakes[i].strength *= Math.pow(0.08, dt);
      if (wakes[i].age > 1.2 || wakes[i].strength < 0.015) {
        wakes.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }

    // Update broth ripples & nudge floating oil droplets / scallions / sesame gently
    for (let i = ripples.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const rp = ripples[i];
      rp.age += dt;
      if (rp.age >= rp.maxAge) {
        ripples.splice(i, 1);
        continue;
      }
      const t = rp.age / rp.maxAge;
      const waveR = rp.maxR * (1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 2.4));
      const band = L.R * 0.08;
      const pushStr = (1 - t) * rp.strength * 0.014 * dt * 60;

      // Gently nudge nearby oil droplets along the expanding wave crest
      for (let j = 0; j < rayuDroplets.length; j++) {
        const d = rayuDroplets[j];
        const pos = brothToLocal(d.bx + d.dx, d.by + d.dy);
        const dx = pos.x - rp.x;
        const dy = (pos.y - rp.y) / L.ryRatio;
        const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
        if (Math.abs(dist - waveR) < band && dist > 1) {
          d.dx += (dx / dist) * pushStr * 0.28;
          d.dy += (dy / dist) * pushStr * 0.28;
        }
      }
      for (let j = 0; j < scallions.length; j++) {
        const s = scallions[j];
        if (!s.floating) continue;
        const pos = brothToLocal(s.bx + s.dx, s.by + s.dy);
        const dx = pos.x - rp.x;
        const dy = (pos.y - rp.y) / L.ryRatio;
        const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
        if (Math.abs(dist - waveR) < band && dist > 1) {
          s.dx += (dx / dist) * pushStr * 0.18;
          s.dy += (dy / dist) * pushStr * 0.18;
        }
      }
    }

    // Gently spring floating items back toward home positions
    const ret = Math.pow(0.28, dt);
    for (let j = 0; j < rayuDroplets.length; j++) {
      rayuDroplets[j].dx *= ret;
      rayuDroplets[j].dy *= ret;
    }
    for (let j = 0; j < scallions.length; j++) {
      scallions[j].dx *= ret;
      scallions[j].dy *= ret;
    }
    for (let j = 0; j < sesameSeeds.length; j++) {
      sesameSeeds[j].dx *= ret;
      sesameSeeds[j].dy *= ret;
    }

    // Step atmospheric dust motes
    for (let i = 0; i < motes.length; i++) {
      const m = motes[i];
      m.nx += (m.vx + Math.sin(elapsed * 0.5 + m.phase) * 0.008) * dt;
      m.ny += m.vy * dt;
      if (m.ny < -2.4) {
        m.ny = -0.15;
        m.nx = (liveSteamRng() - 0.5) * 1.15;
      }
    }

    // Step fluid curl-noise steam
    stepSteam(dt, elapsed, false);
  }

  function renderFrame(timeSec) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);

    const R = L.R;
    const px = reducedMotion ? 0 : ptr.nx;
    const py = reducedMotion ? 0 : ptr.ny;

    // Gentle living pendant light sway + mouse influence
    const lampSway = reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.sin(timeSec * 0.42) * 0.12;
    const lightOffX = px * 0.85 + lampSway;
    const lightOffY = py * 0.65;

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. Dark Atmospheric Room & Charred Wood Counter (subtle back parallax)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    const bgShiftX = -px * 9;
    const bgShiftY = -py * 5;
    ctx.drawImage(
      cache.backdrop.canvas,
      -cache.backdrop.pad + bgShiftX,
      -cache.backdrop.pad + bgShiftY,
      W + cache.backdrop.pad * 2,
      H + cache.backdrop.pad * 2
    );

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. Bowl Root Transform (subtle tactile depth shift)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    const bowlX = L.cx + px * 5;
    const bowlY = L.cy + py * 3;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(bowlX, bowlY);

    // 2a. Ceramic Bowl Exterior & Recessed Inner Cavity
    ctx.drawImage(
      cache.bowlBack.canvas,
      -cache.bowlBack.ox,
      -cache.bowlBack.oy,
      cache.bowlBack.canvas.width / dpr,
      cache.bowlBack.canvas.height / dpr
    );

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. Broth Surface, Submerged Noodles, Dynamic Sheen, Ripples & Oil Droplets
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    ctx.save();
    // Clip strictly to the inner bowl cavity AND broth ellipse
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, L.innerOffY, L.innerRx, L.innerRy, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.clip();

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, L.brothOffY, L.brothRx, L.brothRy, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.clip();

    // Pre-rendered creamy golden-amber miso-sesame broth with imperceptible heat drift
    const driftX = reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.sin(timeSec * 0.32) * 2.2;
    const driftY = reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.cos(timeSec * 0.28) * 1.4;
    ctx.drawImage(
      cache.brothBase.canvas,
      -cache.brothBase.ox + driftX,
      L.brothOffY - cache.brothBase.oy + driftY,
      cache.brothBase.canvas.width / dpr,
      cache.brothBase.canvas.height / dpr
    );

    const pulse = reducedMotion ? 0.5 : (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(timeSec * 0.95));

      return;

      wakes.length = 0;
      ripples.length = 0;

    } else {

    }
  });

    if (document.hidden) {
      stopLoop();
    } else if (!reducedMotion) {
      startLoop();
    }
  });

  let resizeTimer = null;
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    clearTimeout(resizeTimer);

    overBroth: false,
    warmthBoost: 0,
    lastRippleX: 0,
    lastRippleY: 0,
    lastRippleT: 0
  };

  const wakes = [];
  const ripples = [];

  const cache = {
    backdrop: null,
    bowlBack: null,
    bowlFrontLip: null,

    noriBack: null,
    noriFront: null,
    builtR: 0
  };

  function makeCanvas(w, h) {
    const c = document.createElement('canvas');
    c.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(w));
    c.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(h));
    return c;
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 1. Soft Asymmetric Volumetric Vapor Brushes
  // =========================================================================
  function buildSteamBrushes() {
    cache.steamBrushes = [];
    for (let b = 0; b < 4; b++) {
      const s = 144;
      const c = makeCanvas(s, s);
      const g = c.getContext('2d');
      const rng = mulberry32(9001 + b * 211);
      const cx = s * 0.5;
      const cy = s * 0.5;

      // Ultra-soft gossamer vapor base
      const baseGrad = g.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, s * 0.48);
      baseGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 244, 226, 0.28)');
      baseGrad.addColorStop(0.38, 'rgba(255, 238, 214, 0.12)');
      baseGrad.addColorStop(0.74, 'rgba(240, 232, 224, 0.03)');
      baseGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(240, 232, 224, 0)');
      g.fillStyle = baseGrad;
      g.fillRect(0, 0, s, s);

      // Asymmetrical curling wispy cloud lobes
      for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
        const ang = (i / 9) * Math.PI * 2 + rng() * 0.7;
        const dist = s * (0.06 + rng() * 0.17);
        const lx = cx + Math.cos(ang) * dist;
        const ly = cy + Math.sin(ang) * dist;
        const lr = s * (0.15 + rng() * 0.19);
        const lg = g.createRadialGradient(lx, ly, 0, lx, ly, lr);
        lg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 242, 222, 0.14)');
        lg.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(248, 236, 220, 0.045)');
        lg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(245, 236, 225, 0)');
        g.fillStyle = lg;
        g.beginPath();
        g.arc(lx, ly, lr, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        g.fill();
      }
      cache.steamBrushes.push(c);
    }
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 2. Dark Izakaya Backdrop & Seamless Charred Yakisugi Wood Counter
  // =========================================================================
  function buildBackdropCache() {
    const pad = 44;
    const cw = Math.ceil((W + pad * 2) * dpr);
    const ch = Math.ceil((H + pad * 2) * dpr);
    const c = makeCanvas(cw, ch);
    const g = c.getContext('2d');
    g.scale(dpr, dpr);
    g.translate(pad, pad);

    const cx = L.cx;
    const cy = L.cy;
    const R = L.R;

    // Velvety obsidian-umber atmospheric void (zero hard gradients)
    const bgGrad = g.createRadialGradient(
      cx - R * 0.08, cy - R * 0.42, R * 0.08,
      cx, cy - R * 0.12, Math.max(W, H) * 0.92
    );
    bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1c130c');
    bgGrad.addColorStop(0.24, '#120c08');
    bgGrad.addColorStop(0.55, '#090705');
    bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#030202');
    g.fillStyle = bgGrad;
    g.fillRect(-pad, -pad, W + pad * 2, H + pad * 2);

    // Subtle dark charred cedar (yakisugi) wood counter receding smoothly into pitch shadow
    const tableTop = cy - R * 0.36;
    const tableH = H + pad - tableTop;

    const tblGrad = g.createLinearGradient(0, tableTop, 0, H + pad);
    tblGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(9, 6, 4, 0)');
    tblGrad.addColorStop(0.24, 'rgba(18, 13, 9, 0.65)');
    tblGrad.addColorStop(0.56, 'rgba(24, 17, 12, 0.92)');
    tblGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(10, 7, 5, 1)');
    g.fillStyle = tblGrad;
    g.fillRect(-pad, tableTop, W + pad * 2, tableH);

    // Subtle organic wood grain fibers illuminated gently only near the warm bowl pool
    g.save();
    g.beginPath();
    g.rect(-pad, tableTop, W + pad * 2, tableH);
    g.clip();

    const rng = mulberry32(4242);
    const lines = 78;
    for (let i = 0; i < lines; i++) {
      const frac = i / lines;
      const y = tableTop + Math.pow(frac, 1.38) * tableH;
      const distFromPool = Math.abs(y - (cy + R * 0.56)) / (R * 1.45);
      const vis = clamp(1 - distFromPool * 0.68, 0.06, 1) * smoothstep(0, 0.28, frac);
      const isLight = rng() > 0.48;
      g.strokeStyle = isLight
        ? `rgba(136, 92, 52, ${(0.015 + rng() * 0.025) * vis})`
        : `rgba(3, 2, 1, ${(0.10 + rng() * 0.14) * vis})`;
      g.lineWidth = 0.65 + frac * (1.1 + rng() * 2.0);
      g.beginPath();
      const waveFreq = 0.0022 + rng() * 0.0038;
      const waveAmp = 1.2 + rng() * 4.2 * frac;
      const phase = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
      for (let x = -pad; x <= W + pad; x += 26) {
        const wy = y + Math.sin(x * waveFreq + phase) * waveAmp + noise2D(x * 0.007, i * 0.65) * 2.6;
        if (x === -pad) g.moveTo(x, wy);
        else g.lineTo(x, wy);
      }
      g.stroke();
    }
    g.restore();

    // Soft warm golden light pool reflected softly onto the dark charred wood around the bowl
    const poolX = cx - R * 0.06;
    const poolY = cy + R * 0.52;
    g.save();
    g.translate(poolX, poolY);
    g.scale(1.68, 0.58);
    const poolGrad = g.createRadialGradient(0, 0, R * 0.22, 0, 0, R * 1.45);
    poolGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(214, 134, 58, 0.21)');
    poolGrad.addColorStop(0.38, 'rgba(156, 86, 32, 0.10)');
    poolGrad.addColorStop(0.72, 'rgba(84, 42, 14, 0.035)');
    poolGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
    g.fillStyle = poolGrad;
    g.beginPath();
    g.arc(0, 0, R * 1.45, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.fill();
    g.restore();

    cache.backdrop = { canvas: c, pad };
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 3. Handcrafted Dark Tenmoku Stoneware Bowl (Seamless Exterior + Inner + Front Lip)
  // =========================================================================
  function buildBowlCaches() {
    const R = L.R;
    const ry = L.rimRy;
    const depth = L.bowlDepth;
    const margin = Math.ceil(R * 0.36);
    const w = Math.ceil(R * 2 + margin * 2);
    const h = Math.ceil(ry + depth + margin * 2);
    const ox = w * 0.5;
    const oy = ry + margin;

    const c = makeCanvas(w * dpr, h * dpr);
    const g = c.getContext('2d');
    g.scale(dpr, dpr);
    g.translate(ox, oy);

    const footW = R * 0.415;
    const footY = depth * 0.935;
    const footRimY = depth * 1.0;

    function traceBowlBody(ctx2) {
      ctx2.beginPath();
      ctx2.moveTo(R, 0);
      ctx2.bezierCurveTo(
        R * 0.99, depth * 0.47,
        R * 0.72, depth * 0.80,
        footW * 1.05, footY - depth * 0.04
      );
      ctx2.lineTo(footW, footRimY - depth * 0.03);
      ctx2.quadraticCurveTo(0, footRimY + depth * 0.068, -footW, footRimY - depth * 0.03);
      ctx2.lineTo(-footW * 1.05, footY - depth * 0.04);
      ctx2.bezierCurveTo(
        -R * 0.72, depth * 0.80,
        -R * 0.99, depth * 0.47,
        -R, 0
      );
      ctx2.ellipse(0, 0, R, ry, 0, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2, false);
      ctx2.closePath();
    }

    // 1) Grounded table shadows beneath the bowl
    g.save();
    g.translate(R * 0.13, footRimY + depth * 0.015);
    g.scale(1.24, 0.37);
    const castGrad = g.createRadialGradient(0, 0, R * 0.16, 0, 0, R * 1.02);
    castGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(1, 1, 0, 0.90)');
    castGrad.addColorStop(0.45, 'rgba(3, 2, 1, 0.56)');
    castGrad.addColorStop(0.78, 'rgba(3, 2, 1, 0.18)');
    castGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(3, 2, 1, 0)');
    g.fillStyle = castGrad;
    g.beginPath();
    g.arc(0, 0, R * 1.02, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.fill();
    g.restore();

    g.save();
    g.translate(R * 0.02, footRimY + depth * 0.02);
    g.scale(1.0, 0.32);
    const aoGrad = g.createRadialGradient(0, 0, footW * 0.45, 0, 0, footW * 1.26);
    aoGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.97)');
    aoGrad.addColorStop(0.75, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.72)');
    aoGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
    g.fillStyle = aoGrad;
    g.beginPath();
    g.arc(0, 0, footW * 1.26, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.fill();
    g.restore();

    // 2) Seamless Exterior Stoneware Body Shading
    g.save();
    traceBowlBody(g);
    g.clip();

    const bodyGrad = g.createRadialGradient(
      -R * 0.45, depth * 0.22, R * 0.06,
      R * 0.08, depth * 0.42, R * 1.42
    );
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#3d2f25');
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.26, '#281f19');
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.58, '#16110e');
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.86, '#0b0807');
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#111216');
    g.fillStyle = bodyGrad;
    g.fillRect(-R - 10, -ry - 10, R * 2 + 20, ry + depth + 40);

    // Seamless curved kiln-fired russet-iron rim glaze hugging the upper rim ellipse (NO flat horizontal band!)
    g.save();
    g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(134, 76, 38, 0.28)';
    g.lineWidth = R * 0.16;
    g.filter = 'blur(7px)';
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(0, depth * 0.02, R * 0.99, ry * 1.03, 0, 0.02, Math.PI - 0.02);
    g.stroke();
    g.filter = 'none';
    g.restore();

    // Warm reflected bounce light from the table onto lower-left stoneware belly
    const bounceGrad = g.createRadialGradient(
      -R * 0.28, depth * 0.72, R * 0.04,
      -R * 0.18, depth * 0.76, R * 0.64
    );
    bounceGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(192, 118, 56, 0.24)');
    bounceGrad.addColorStop(0.52, 'rgba(138, 78, 34, 0.085)');
    bounceGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
    g.fillStyle = bounceGrad;
    g.fillRect(-R, 0, R * 2, depth + 20);

    // Subtle cool nocturnal slate rim highlight on far right stoneware shoulder
    const coolRim = g.createRadialGradient(
      R * 0.94, depth * 0.22, R * 0.02,
      R * 0.84, depth * 0.28, R * 0.48
    );
    coolRim.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(138, 168, 206, 0.19)');
    coolRim.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(104, 134, 174, 0.07)');
    coolRim.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
    g.fillStyle = coolRim;
    g.fillRect(0, -ry, R + 10, depth + ry);

    // Delicate curved potter's wheel concentric throwing ridges following true bowl curvature
    const rng = mulberry32(7731);
    for (let i = 0; i < 22; i++) {
      const f = (i + 0.5) / 22;
      const gy = ry * 0.68 + f * (depth - ry * 0.76);
      const halfSpan = R * (1.0 - Math.pow(f, 1.75) * 0.55);
      const sag = ry * 0.50 * (1 - f * 0.52);
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(-halfSpan, gy - sag * 0.35);
      g.quadraticCurveTo(0, gy + sag * 0.72, halfSpan, gy - sag * 0.35);
      g.strokeStyle = i % 2 === 0
        ? `rgba(255, 224, 188, ${0.015 + rng() * 0.017})`
        : `rgba(0, 0, 0, ${0.11 + rng() * 0.09})`;
      g.lineWidth = 0.9 + rng() * 1.3;
      g.stroke();
    }

    // Foot ring (kodai) unglazed dark stoneware collar shadow
    g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.58)';
    g.lineWidth = Math.max(2, R * 0.016);
    g.beginPath();
    g.moveTo(-footW * 1.05, footY - depth * 0.035);
    g.quadraticCurveTo(0, footY + depth * 0.062, footW * 1.05, footY - depth * 0.035);
    g.stroke();

    // Matte ceramic mineral iron speckles across exterior body
    const speckCount = Math.floor(R * 4.5);
    for (let i = 0; i < speckCount; i++) {
      const sx = (rng() * 2 - 1) * R;
      const sy = rng() * depth;
      const lightSide = smoothstep(R * 0.75, -R * 0.75, sx);
      const sz = 0.5 + rng() * 1.25;
      g.fillStyle = rng() > 0.36
        ? `rgba(220, 178, 138, ${(0.018 + rng() * 0.042) * (0.3 + lightSide * 0.7)})`
        : `rgba(8, 5, 4, ${0.14 + rng() * 0.16})`;
      g.beginPath();
      g.arc(sx, sy, sz, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
    }

    // Soft glossy stoneware vertical sheen patch on warm left shoulder
    const sheenGrad = g.createRadialGradient(
      -R * 0.58, depth * 0.40, R * 0.02,
      -R * 0.55, depth * 0.44, R * 0.38
    );
    sheenGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 220, 172, 0.15)');
    sheenGrad.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(230, 175, 118, 0.045)');
    sheenGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
    g.fillStyle = sheenGrad;
    g.fillRect(-R, 0, R, depth);

    g.restore();

    // 3) Outer Ceramic Rim Top Surface (full ellipse)
    const rimGrad = g.createLinearGradient(-R, -ry, R, ry);
    rimGrad.addColorStop(0, '#7c4a2b');
    rimGrad.addColorStop(0.26, '#5e3720');
    rimGrad.addColorStop(0.55, '#3b2418');
    rimGrad.addColorStop(0.84, '#241711');
    rimGrad.addColorStop(1, '#4c3e3a');
    g.fillStyle = rimGrad;
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(0, 0, R, ry, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.fill();

    // Subtle warm kiln-glaze highlight on upper-left back rim
    g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 214, 164, 0.40)';
    g.lineWidth = Math.max(1.2, R * 0.008);
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(0, 0, R * 0.985, ry * 0.985, 0, Math.PI * 1.06, Math.PI * 1.58);
    g.stroke();

    // 4) Recessed Inner Ceramic Cavity (visible crescent above broth)
    g.save();
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(0, L.innerOffY, L.innerRx, L.innerRy, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.clip();

    const innerGrad = g.createLinearGradient(0, -L.innerRy, 0, L.innerRy);
    innerGrad.addColorStop(0, '#16100c');
    innerGrad.addColorStop(0.26, '#291c13');
    innerGrad.addColorStop(0.50, '#3e2715');
    innerGrad.addColorStop(1, '#120c09');
    g.fillStyle = innerGrad;
    g.fillRect(-R, -ry, R * 2, ry * 2 + 20);

    // Warm broth reflection bouncing onto back inner ceramic wall
    const wallBounce = g.createRadialGradient(
      -R * 0.08, L.brothOffY - L.brothRy * 0.72, R * 0.08,
      0, L.brothOffY - L.brothRy * 0.5, R * 0.92
    );
    wallBounce.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(242, 152, 56, 0.30)');
    wallBounce.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(186, 102, 32, 0.13)');
    wallBounce.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
    g.fillStyle = wallBounce;
    g.fillRect(-R, -ry, R * 2, ry * 2);

    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      g.strokeStyle = i % 2 === 0 ? 'rgba(255, 216, 166, 0.036)' : 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16)';
      g.lineWidth = 1.2;
      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(0, L.innerOffY + i * R * 0.022, L.innerRx * (0.99 - i * 0.008), L.innerRy * (0.99 - i * 0.008), 0, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
      g.stroke();
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < 160; i++) {
      const ang = Math.PI + rng() * Math.PI;
      const rad = 0.82 + rng() * 0.18;
      const sx = Math.cos(ang) * L.innerRx * rad;
      const sy = L.innerOffY + Math.sin(ang) * L.innerRy * rad;
      g.fillStyle = `rgba(220, 180, 138, ${0.03 + rng() * 0.05})`;
      g.fillRect(sx, sy, 1.1, 1.1);
    }
    g.restore();

    g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(20, 12, 8, 0.65)';
    g.lineWidth = Math.max(1.2, R * 0.009);
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(0, L.innerOffY, L.innerRx, L.innerRy, 0, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
    g.stroke();

    // --- Front Ceramic Lip Overlay (clips cleanly over front edge of broth & toppings) ---
    const lf = makeCanvas(w * dpr, h * dpr);
    const fg = lf.getContext('2d');
    fg.scale(dpr, dpr);
    fg.translate(ox, oy);

    fg.save();
    fg.beginPath();
    fg.rect(-R - 10, 0, R * 2 + 20, ry + 30);
    fg.clip();

    fg.beginPath();
    fg.ellipse(0, 0, R, ry, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    fg.ellipse(0, L.innerOffY, L.innerRx, L.innerRy, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2, true);

    const fRimGrad = fg.createLinearGradient(-R, 0, R, ry);
    fRimGrad.addColorStop(0, '#78482a');
    fRimGrad.addColorStop(0.28, '#623820');
    fRimGrad.addColorStop(0.55, '#472919');
    fRimGrad.addColorStop(0.84, '#291a12');
    fRimGrad.addColorStop(1, '#3e3535');
    fg.fillStyle = fRimGrad;
    fg.fill('evenodd');

    fg.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 218, 168, 0.44)';
    fg.lineWidth = Math.max(1.3, R * 0.009);
    fg.beginPath();
    fg.ellipse(0, L.innerOffY * 0.4, (R + L.innerRx) * 0.5, (ry + L.innerRy) * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 0.12, Math.PI * 0.88);
    fg.stroke();

    fg.strokeStyle = 'rgba(12, 6, 3, 0.58)';
    fg.lineWidth = Math.max(1.1, R * 0.007);
    fg.beginPath();
    fg.ellipse(0, L.innerOffY, L.innerRx, L.innerRy, 0, 0.02, Math.PI - 0.02);
    fg.stroke();

    fg.restore();

    cache.bowlBack = { canvas: c, ox, oy };
    cache.bowlFrontLip = { canvas: lf, ox, oy };
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 4. Rich Luminous Creamy Miso-Sesame Broth Base Cache
  // =========================================================================
  function buildBrothBaseCache() {
    const rx = L.brothRx;
    const ry = L.brothRy;
    const pad = 12;
    const w = Math.ceil((rx + pad) * 2);
    const h = Math.ceil((ry + pad) * 2);
    const ox = w * 0.5;
    const oy = h * 0.5;

    const c = makeCanvas(w * dpr, h * dpr);
    const g = c.getContext('2d');
    g.scale(dpr, dpr);
    g.translate(ox, oy);

    g.save();
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(0, 0, rx, ry, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.clip();

    // Rich glowing golden-amber miso-tantanmen base
    g.save();
    g.scale(1, ry / rx);
    const bGrad = g.createRadialGradient(
      -rx * 0.12, -rx * 0.08, rx * 0.05,
      rx * 0.02, rx * 0.04, rx * 1.04
    );
    bGrad.addColorStop(0, '#f3ad44');
    bGrad.addColorStop(0.28, '#d98124');
    bGrad.addColorStop(0.58, '#a64f12');
    bGrad.addColorStop(0.84, '#6d2c08');
    bGrad.addColorStop(1, '#3a1404');
    g.fillStyle = bGrad;
    g.fillRect(-rx - 4, -rx - 4, rx * 2 + 8, rx * 2 + 8);
    g.restore();

    // Velvety creamy sesame-miso emulsion swirls (organic rich texture)
    const rng = mulberry32(31415);
    for (let i = 0; i < 82; i++) {
      const ang = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
      const dist = Math.sqrt(rng()) * 0.88;
      const mx = Math.cos(ang) * rx * dist;
      const my = Math.sin(ang) * ry * dist;
      const mr = rx * (0.08 + rng() * 0.22);
      const isWarmCream = rng() > 0.32;
      g.save();
      g.translate(mx, my);
      g.rotate(rng() * Math.PI);
      g.scale(1.55, 0.58);
      const mg = g.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, mr);
      if (isWarmCream) {
        mg.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 214, 126, ${0.085 + rng() * 0.095})`);
        mg.addColorStop(0.52, `rgba(232, 152, 52, ${0.035 + rng() * 0.035})`);
        mg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(232, 152, 52, 0)');
      } else {
        mg.addColorStop(0, `rgba(72, 22, 4, ${0.10 + rng() * 0.11})`);
        mg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(72, 22, 4, 0)');
      }
      g.fillStyle = mg;
      g.beginPath();
      g.arc(0, 0, mr, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
      g.restore();
    }

    // Fine toasted miso-sesame sediment flecks suspended in the golden soup
    for (let i = 0; i < 260; i++) {
      const ang = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
      const dist = Math.sqrt(rng()) * 0.94;
      const sx = Math.cos(ang) * rx * dist;
      const sy = Math.sin(ang) * ry * dist;
      g.fillStyle = rng() > 0.42
        ? `rgba(105, 38, 8, ${0.14 + rng() * 0.18})`
        : `rgba(255, 222, 146, ${0.10 + rng() * 0.14})`;
      g.beginPath();
      g.arc(sx, sy, 0.7 + rng() * 1.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
    }

    // Luminous sunlit golden subsurface core bloom
    g.save();
    g.scale(1, ry / rx);
    const bloom = g.createRadialGradient(-rx * 0.10, -rx * 0.06, 0, -rx * 0.06, -rx * 0.04, rx * 0.65);
    bloom.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 232, 154, 0.30)');
    bloom.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(248, 174, 68, 0.10)');
    bloom.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(248, 174, 68, 0)');
    g.fillStyle = bloom;
    g.fillRect(-rx, -rx, rx * 2, rx * 2);
    g.restore();

    // Wet broth perimeter meniscus dark shadow + luminous amber-gold curved liquid edge
    g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(26, 8, 2, 0.56)';
    g.lineWidth = Math.max(3, rx * 0.024);
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(0, 0, rx - 1, ry - 1, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);

    g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 212, 134, 0.42)';

    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(0, 0, rx - Math.max(2, rx * 0.012), ry - Math.max(1.5, ry * 0.014), 0, Math.PI * 1.03, Math.PI * 1.96);

  // --- A. Scored Shiitake Mushroom Cap (Kazari-giri star carving) ---
  function buildShiitakeSprite(radius, seed) {
    const rng = mulberry32(seed);
    const w = Math.ceil(radius * 2.8);
    const h = Math.ceil(radius * 2.4);
    const ox = w * 0.5;
    const oy = h * 0.52;
    const c = makeCanvas(w * dpr, h * dpr);
    const g = c.getContext('2d');
    g.scale(dpr, dpr);
    g.translate(ox, oy);

    // Rich broth contact shadow
    g.save();
    g.scale(1.08, 0.78);
    const sh = g.createRadialGradient(radius * 0.08, radius * 0.22, radius * 0.4, radius * 0.08, radius * 0.22, radius * 1.25);
    sh.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(34, 11, 2, 0.66)');
    sh.addColorStop(0.65, 'rgba(54, 18, 4, 0.30)');
    sh.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(54, 18, 4, 0)');
    g.fillStyle = sh;
    g.beginPath();
    g.arc(radius * 0.08, radius * 0.22, radius * 1.25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.fill();
    g.restore();

    // Subtle gill edge tucked into the broth
    g.fillStyle = '#9c7046';
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(radius * 0.05, radius * 0.20, radius * 0.92, radius * 0.60, 0.06, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.fill();

    function traceCap(ctx2, scaleX, scaleY) {
      const pts = 28;
      ctx2.beginPath();
      for (let i = 0; i <= pts; i++) {
        const a = (i / pts) * Math.PI * 2;
        const wob = 1 + Math.sin(a * 3 + seed) * 0.034 + Math.cos(a * 5 + seed * 1.7) * 0.02;
        const px = Math.cos(a) * radius * scaleX * wob;
        const py = Math.sin(a) * radius * scaleY * wob - radius * 0.04;
        if (i === 0) ctx2.moveTo(px, py);
        else ctx2.lineTo(px, py);
      }
      ctx2.closePath();
    }

    g.save();
    traceCap(g, 1.0, 0.73);
    g.clip();

    const capGrad = g.createRadialGradient(
      -radius * 0.32, -radius * 0.28, radius * 0.05,
      radius * 0.05, radius * 0.02, radius * 1.08
    );
    capGrad.addColorStop(0, '#9c5c32');
    capGrad.addColorStop(0.26, '#723c1d');
    capGrad.addColorStop(0.60, '#44210e');
    capGrad.addColorStop(0.88, '#261006');
    capGrad.addColorStop(1, '#190a04');
    g.fillStyle = capGrad;
    g.fillRect(-radius * 1.2, -radius, radius * 2.4, radius * 2);

    for (let i = 0; i < 52; i++) {
      const a = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
      const d = Math.sqrt(rng()) * 0.9;
      const mx = Math.cos(a) * radius * d;
      const my = Math.sin(a) * radius * 0.72 * d;
      const mr = radius * (0.05 + rng() * 0.11);
      g.fillStyle = rng() > 0.45
        ? `rgba(182, 122, 74, ${0.06 + rng() * 0.08})`
        : `rgba(22, 8, 3, ${0.15 + rng() * 0.16})`;
      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(mx, my, mr, mr * 0.7, rng() * Math.PI, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
      const a = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
      const d = 0.72 + rng() * 0.22;
      const mx = Math.cos(a) * radius * d;
      const my = Math.sin(a) * radius * 0.72 * d;
      g.fillStyle = `rgba(232, 200, 158, ${0.12 + rng() * 0.16})`;
      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(mx, my, radius * 0.04, radius * 0.022, a, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
    }

    // Decorative 6-pointed Kazari-giri star carving
    const cutCenterX = -radius * 0.04;
    const cutCenterY = -radius * 0.12;
    const cutAngles = [-0.22, 0.84, 1.90];
    for (let k = 0; k < cutAngles.length; k++) {
      const ang = cutAngles[k] + (seed % 3) * 0.09;
      const len = radius * 0.62;
      const wid = radius * 0.115;

      g.save();
      g.translate(cutCenterX, cutCenterY);
      g.scale(1, 0.74);
      g.rotate(ang);

      g.fillStyle = 'rgba(22, 8, 2, 0.82)';
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(-len * 1.04, 0);
      g.quadraticCurveTo(0, -wid * 1.26, len * 1.04, 0);
      g.quadraticCurveTo(0, wid * 1.26, -len * 1.04, 0);
      g.closePath();
      g.fill();

      const fleshGrad = g.createLinearGradient(0, -wid, 0, wid);
      fleshGrad.addColorStop(0, '#f2deb9');
      fleshGrad.addColorStop(0.45, '#e0c191');
      fleshGrad.addColorStop(0.55, '#b68752');
      fleshGrad.addColorStop(1, '#ead0a6');
      g.fillStyle = fleshGrad;
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(-len, 0);
      g.quadraticCurveTo(0, -wid, len, 0);
      g.quadraticCurveTo(0, wid, -len, 0);
      g.closePath();
      g.fill();

      g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(88, 46, 18, 0.58)';
      g.lineWidth = Math.max(0.8, radius * 0.024);
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(-len * 0.88, 0);
      g.lineTo(len * 0.88, 0);
      g.stroke();
      g.restore();
    }

    const starGlow = g.createRadialGradient(cutCenterX, cutCenterY, 0, cutCenterX, cutCenterY, radius * 0.21);
    starGlow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(248, 230, 198, 0.56)');
    starGlow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(248, 230, 198, 0)');
    g.fillStyle = starGlow;
    g.beginPath();
    g.arc(cutCenterX, cutCenterY, radius * 0.21, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.fill();

    // Luscious soy-tare glaze specular highlights
    g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 236, 200, 0.30)';
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(-radius * 0.36, -radius * 0.28, radius * 0.24, radius * 0.10, -0.45, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.fill();

    g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 250, 234, 0.68)';
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(-radius * 0.40, -radius * 0.31, radius * 0.09, radius * 0.036, -0.45, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.fill();

    g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 224, 178, 0.20)';
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(radius * 0.34, -radius * 0.18, radius * 0.15, radius * 0.055, 0.35, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.fill();
    g.restore();

    // Warm golden liquid meniscus clinging to submerged lower cap rim
    g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 214, 134, 0.45)';
    g.lineWidth = Math.max(1.2, radius * 0.028);
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(0, radius * 0.02, radius * 0.96, radius * 0.70, 0, Math.PI * 0.14, Math.PI * 0.86);
    g.stroke();

    return { canvas: c, ox, oy };
  }

  // --- B. Perspective-True Thick Seared Artisanal Tofu Slab ---
  function buildTofuSprite(wSize, hSize, thickness, seed) {
    const rng = mulberry32(seed);
    // Foreshorten top face in true 3/4 view so slabs lie naturally inside the bowl!
    const topH = hSize * 0.74;
    const pad = Math.ceil(Math.max(wSize, hSize) * 0.44);
    const cw = Math.ceil(wSize + pad * 2);
    const ch = Math.ceil(topH + thickness + pad * 2);
    const ox = cw * 0.5;
    const oy = ch * 0.48;
    const c = makeCanvas(cw * dpr, ch * dpr);
    const g = c.getContext('2d');
    g.scale(dpr, dpr);
    g.translate(ox, oy);

    const hw = wSize * 0.5;
    const hh = topH * 0.5;
    const rad = Math.min(wSize, topH) * 0.22;

    // Slight organic hand-cut bevelled pillow-rectangle path
    function traceSlab(ctx2, x, y, w, h, r) {
      ctx2.beginPath();
      ctx2.moveTo(x + r, y);
      ctx2.quadraticCurveTo(x + w * 0.5, y - h * 0.04, x + w - r, y);
      ctx2.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
      ctx2.quadraticCurveTo(x + w + w * 0.02, y + h * 0.5, x + w, y + h - r);
      ctx2.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
      ctx2.quadraticCurveTo(x + w * 0.5, y + h + h * 0.04, x + r, y + h);
      ctx2.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
      ctx2.quadraticCurveTo(x - w * 0.02, y + h * 0.5, x, y + r);
      ctx2.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
      ctx2.closePath();
    }

    // Soft warm amber contact shadow beneath slab
    g.save();
    g.fillStyle = 'rgba(42, 13, 2, 0.54)';
    g.filter = 'blur(5px)';
    traceSlab(g, -hw + 2, -hh + thickness * 0.92, wSize + 3, topH + 3, rad);
    g.fill();
    g.filter = 'none';
    g.restore();

    // 1) Silky creamy tofu side-wall (extruded downward)
    g.save();
    traceSlab(g, -hw, -hh + thickness, wSize, topH, rad);
    g.clip();
    const sideGrad = g.createLinearGradient(-hw, -hh + thickness, hw, hh + thickness);
    sideGrad.addColorStop(0, '#f5e7ca');
    sideGrad.addColorStop(0.52, '#e2c797');
    sideGrad.addColorStop(1, '#b58d55');
    g.fillStyle = sideGrad;
    g.fillRect(-hw - 4, -hh, wSize + 8, topH + thickness + 8);

    // Rich broth soaking gradient along bottom immersed half of side wall
    const soakGrad = g.createLinearGradient(0, hh - thickness * 0.1, 0, hh + thickness * 1.1);
    soakGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(195, 108, 22, 0)');
    soakGrad.addColorStop(0.45, 'rgba(176, 86, 16, 0.42)');
    soakGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(116, 44, 6, 0.78)');
    g.fillStyle = soakGrad;
    g.fillRect(-hw - 4, hh - thickness * 0.4, wSize + 8, thickness * 1.9);

    for (let i = 0; i < 36; i++) {
      const px = -hw + rng() * wSize;
      const py = hh - topH * 0.08 + rng() * (thickness + topH * 0.1);
      g.fillStyle = `rgba(140, 100, 58, ${0.12 + rng() * 0.16})`;
      g.beginPath();
      g.arc(px, py, 0.6 + rng() * 1.1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
    }
    g.restore();

    // Seamless vertical side bridges
    g.fillStyle = '#e5ce9f';
    g.fillRect(-hw, -hh + rad, rad * 0.5, thickness);
    g.fillStyle = '#ba925a';
    g.fillRect(hw - rad * 0.5, -hh + rad, rad * 0.5, thickness);

    // 2) Crispy Golden Pan-Seared Top Crust
    g.save();
    traceSlab(g, -hw, -hh, wSize, topH, rad);
    g.clip();

    const topGrad = g.createLinearGradient(-hw, -hh, hw, hh);
    topGrad.addColorStop(0, '#ecb762');
    topGrad.addColorStop(0.32, '#d28430');
    topGrad.addColorStop(0.68, '#a45218');
    topGrad.addColorStop(1, '#75320c');
    g.fillStyle = topGrad;
    g.fillRect(-hw - 4, -hh - 4, wSize + 8, topH + 8);

    // Rich lacy pan-seared blister mottling
    for (let i = 0; i < 110; i++) {
      const px = -hw + rng() * wSize;
      const py = -hh + rng() * topH;
      const pr = 1.4 + rng() * (wSize * 0.082);
      const isDarkSear = rng() > 0.40;
      g.fillStyle = isDarkSear
        ? `rgba(82, 30, 6, ${0.14 + rng() * 0.24})`
        : `rgba(255, 218, 138, ${0.10 + rng() * 0.17})`;
      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(px, py, pr, pr * (0.48 + rng() * 0.45), rng() * Math.PI, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
    }

    // Subtle smoky pan-sear char lines
    g.save();
    g.rotate(-0.32);
    for (let s = -1; s <= 1; s++) {
      const sy = s * topH * 0.30;
      const sg = g.createLinearGradient(0, sy - 4.5, 0, sy + 4.5);
      sg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(60, 18, 4, 0)');
      sg.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(58, 18, 3, 0.38)');
      sg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(60, 18, 4, 0)');
      g.fillStyle = sg;
      g.fillRect(-wSize, sy - 4.5, wSize * 2, 9);
    }
    g.restore();

    // Soft ivory-gold beveled transition edge
    g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(252, 232, 186, 0.46)';
    g.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, wSize * 0.032);
    traceSlab(g, -hw + 1, -hh + 1, wSize - 2, topH - 2, rad * 0.9);
    g.stroke();

    // Glossy soy-sesame glaze specular sheen
    const glz = g.createRadialGradient(-hw * 0.42, -hh * 0.35, 1, -hw * 0.34, -hh * 0.25, wSize * 0.46);
    glz.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 248, 222, 0.48)');
    glz.addColorStop(0.4, 'rgba(255, 224, 162, 0.16)');
    glz.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 224, 162, 0)');
    g.fillStyle = glz;
    g.fillRect(-hw, -hh, wSize, topH);

    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      const sx = -hw * 0.62 + rng() * wSize * 0.62;
      const sy = -hh * 0.60 + rng() * topH * 0.55;
      g.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 252, 238, ${0.38 + rng() * 0.36})`;
      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(sx, sy, 1.5 + rng() * 1.9, 0.85 + rng() * 0.8, -0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
    }
    g.restore();

    // Crisp luminous broth meniscus hugging bottom submerged wall
    g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 214, 134, 0.48)';
    g.lineWidth = 1.4;
    g.beginPath();
    g.moveTo(-hw + rad * 0.8, hh + thickness - 0.5);
    g.quadraticCurveTo(0, hh + thickness + topH * 0.04, hw - rad * 0.8, hh + thickness - 0.5);
    g.stroke();

    return { canvas: c, ox, oy };
  }

  // --- C. Pan-Seared Lotus Root (Renkon) Slice ---
  function buildLotusSprite(radius, seed) {
    const rng = mulberry32(seed);
    const w = Math.ceil(radius * 2.7);
    const h = Math.ceil(radius * 2.3);
    const ox = w * 0.5;
    const oy = h * 0.5;
    const c = makeCanvas(w * dpr, h * dpr);
    const g = c.getContext('2d');
    g.scale(dpr, dpr);
    g.translate(ox, oy);

    g.fillStyle = 'rgba(42, 13, 2, 0.46)';
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(radius * 0.06, radius * 0.15, radius * 1.02, radius * 0.70, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.fill();

    function traceLotus(ctx2, scX, scY, offY) {
      const pts = 44;
      ctx2.beginPath();
      for (let i = 0; i <= pts; i++) {
        const a = (i / pts) * Math.PI * 2;
        const scallop = 0.96 + Math.cos(a * 7 + seed) * 0.042;
        const px = Math.cos(a) * radius * scX * scallop;
        const py = Math.sin(a) * radius * scY * scallop + offY;
        if (i === 0) ctx2.moveTo(px, py);
        else ctx2.lineTo(px, py);
      }
      ctx2.closePath();
    }

    const holes = [];
    const holeCount = 7;
    for (let i = 0; i < holeCount; i++) {
      const a = (i / holeCount) * Math.PI * 2 + 0.25 + seed * 0.1;
      const dist = radius * 0.52;
      holes.push({
        x: Math.cos(a) * dist,
        y: Math.sin(a) * dist * 0.68,
        rx: radius * (0.14 + (i % 2) * 0.024),
        ry: radius * (0.105 + (i % 2) * 0.015),
        rot: a
      });
    }
    holes.push({ x: 0, y: 0, rx: radius * 0.068, ry: radius * 0.052, rot: 0 });

    g.save();
    traceLotus(g, 1.0, 0.69, radius * 0.11);
    g.fillStyle = '#8b5526';
    g.fill();
    g.restore();

    g.save();
    traceLotus(g, 1.0, 0.69, 0);
    g.clip();

    const lGrad = g.createRadialGradient(
      -radius * 0.25, -radius * 0.18, radius * 0.05,
      0, 0, radius * 1.05
    );
    lGrad.addColorStop(0, '#f6e6c5');
    lGrad.addColorStop(0.55, '#e2c088');
    lGrad.addColorStop(0.84, '#c08744');
    lGrad.addColorStop(1, '#874c1c');
    g.fillStyle = lGrad;
    g.fillRect(-radius * 1.1, -radius, radius * 2.2, radius * 2);

    for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
      const a = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
      const d = 0.2 + rng() * 0.65;
      const sx = Math.cos(a) * radius * d;
      const sy = Math.sin(a) * radius * 0.66 * d;
      const sr = radius * (0.12 + rng() * 0.18);
      const sg = g.createRadialGradient(sx, sy, 0, sx, sy, sr);
      sg.addColorStop(0, `rgba(164, 80, 20, ${0.15 + rng() * 0.16})`);
      sg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(164, 80, 20, 0)');
      g.fillStyle = sg;
      g.beginPath();
      g.arc(sx, sy, sr, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
    }

    g.strokeStyle = '#703b14';
    g.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, radius * 0.06);
    traceLotus(g, 0.99, 0.68, 0);
    g.stroke();

    for (let i = 0; i < holes.length; i++) {
      const hl = holes[i];
      g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 242, 210, 0.45)';
      g.lineWidth = 1.2;
      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(hl.x, hl.y, hl.rx + 0.8, hl.ry + 0.8, hl.rot, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.stroke();

      g.fillStyle = '#9c6530';
      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(hl.x, hl.y, hl.rx, hl.ry, hl.rot, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();

      g.save();
      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(hl.x, hl.y, hl.rx, hl.ry, hl.rot, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.clip();
      const holeGrad = g.createRadialGradient(hl.x + 1, hl.y + hl.ry * 0.35, 0.5, hl.x, hl.y + 1, hl.rx * 1.15);
      holeGrad.addColorStop(0, '#9e4810');
      holeGrad.addColorStop(0.55, '#5a2206');
      holeGrad.addColorStop(1, '#2b0f02');
      g.fillStyle = holeGrad;
      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(hl.x + hl.rx * 0.08, hl.y + hl.ry * 0.28, hl.rx * 0.92, hl.ry * 0.86, hl.rot, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
      g.restore();
    }

    g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 250, 236, 0.26)';
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(-radius * 0.25, -radius * 0.20, radius * 0.38, radius * 0.13, -0.35, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.fill();
    g.restore();

    return { canvas: c, ox, oy };
  }

  // --- D. Charred Baby Bok Choy (Organically Ruffled Steamed-Jade Leaves + Glossy Stalks) ---
  function buildBokChoySprite(scaleR) {
    const w = Math.ceil(scaleR * 1.48);
    const h = Math.ceil(scaleR * 1.28);
    const ox = w * 0.42;
    const oy = h * 0.54;
    const c = makeCanvas(w * dpr, h * dpr);
    const g = c.getContext('2d');
    g.scale(dpr, dpr);
    g.translate(ox, oy);

    function drawFrond(angle, len, leafW, stalkW, shadeMult, charTip, ruffleSeed) {
      g.save();
      g.rotate(angle);

      // Soft contact shadow
      g.fillStyle = 'rgba(22, 10, 2, 0.38)';
      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(len * 0.46, leafW * 0.22, len * 0.48, leafW * 0.50, 0.06, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();

      // Organically ruffled bok choy leaf contour
      function traceRuffledLeaf(ctx2) {
        const pts = 32;
        ctx2.beginPath();
        for (let i = 0; i <= pts; i++) {
          const u = i / pts; // 0..1 around leaf perimeter
          const theta = u * Math.PI * 2;
          // Paddle envelope centered at len*0.64
          const cx = len * 0.62;
          const rx = len * 0.38;
          const baseX = cx + Math.cos(theta) * rx;
          // Narrower near stalk, broader near tip
          const taper = 0.58 + 0.52 * smoothstep(len * 0.24, len * 0.85, baseX);
          const ruffle = 1 + Math.sin(theta * 7 + ruffleSeed) * 0.075 + Math.cos(theta * 11 + ruffleSeed * 1.6) * 0.04;
          const baseY = Math.sin(theta) * leafW * 0.82 * taper * ruffle;
          if (i === 0) ctx2.moveTo(baseX, baseY);
          else ctx2.lineTo(baseX, baseY);
        }
        ctx2.closePath();
      }

      g.save();
      traceRuffledLeaf(g);
      g.clip();

      const lg = g.createLinearGradient(len * 0.24, -leafW * 0.72, len * 1.0, leafW * 0.68);

  // --- E. Crisp Roasted Toasted Nori Seaweed Sheet ---
  function buildNoriSprite(wSize, hSize, seed) {
    const rng = mulberry32(seed);
    const pad = Math.ceil(Math.max(wSize, hSize) * 0.24);
    const cw = Math.ceil(wSize + pad * 2);
    const ch = Math.ceil(hSize + pad * 2);
    const ox = cw * 0.5;
    const oy = ch - pad;
    const c = makeCanvas(cw * dpr, ch * dpr);
    const g = c.getContext('2d');
    g.scale(dpr, dpr);
    g.translate(ox, oy);

    const bw = wSize * 0.45;
    const tw = wSize * 0.52;
    const curl = (seed % 2 === 0 ? 1 : -1) * wSize * 0.055;

    function traceNori(ctx2) {
      ctx2.beginPath();
      ctx2.moveTo(-bw, 0);
      ctx2.quadraticCurveTo(-bw - curl * 0.6, -hSize * 0.52, -tw + curl, -hSize);
      ctx2.quadraticCurveTo(0, -hSize - hSize * 0.035, tw + curl, -hSize + hSize * 0.02);
      ctx2.quadraticCurveTo(bw + curl * 0.4, -hSize * 0.48, bw, 0);
      ctx2.closePath();
    }

    g.save();
    g.translate(4, 3);
    g.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.52)';
    traceNori(g);
    g.fill();
    g.restore();

    g.save();
    traceNori(g);
    g.clip();

    // Rich deep smoky charcoal-emerald roasted seaweed
    const ng = g.createLinearGradient(-tw, -hSize, tw, 0);
    ng.addColorStop(0, '#1b281a');
    ng.addColorStop(0.32, '#101a11');
    ng.addColorStop(0.70, '#0a110b');
    ng.addColorStop(1, '#060a07');
    g.fillStyle = ng;
    g.fillRect(-tw - 14, -hSize - 14, tw * 2 + 28, hSize + 28);

    // Crispy pressed seaweed fiber micro-texture
    for (let i = 0; i < 460; i++) {
      const fx = (rng() * 2 - 1) * tw * 1.1;
      const fy = -rng() * hSize * 1.04;
      const fl = 3 + rng() * (wSize * 0.14);
      const fa = rng() * Math.PI;
      const isHighlight = rng() > 0.60;
      g.strokeStyle = isHighlight
        ? `rgba(68, 108, 60, ${0.14 + rng() * 0.22})`
        : `rgba(3, 6, 4, ${0.36 + rng() * 0.36})`;
      g.lineWidth = 0.6 + rng() * 0.95;
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(fx, fy);
      g.lineTo(fx + Math.cos(fa) * fl, fy + Math.sin(fa) * fl);
      g.stroke();
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < 24; i++) {
      const px = (rng() * 2 - 1) * tw * 0.85;
      const py = -hSize * (0.48 + rng() * 0.48);
      g.fillStyle = `rgba(116, 158, 84, ${0.14 + rng() * 0.18})`;
      g.fillRect(px, py, 1.2, 1.0);
    }

    const sheen = g.createLinearGradient(-tw, -hSize, tw * 0.6, -hSize * 0.2);
    sheen.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(210, 204, 155, 0.15)');
    sheen.addColorStop(0.45, 'rgba(140, 165, 118, 0.05)');
    sheen.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
    g.fillStyle = sheen;
    g.fillRect(-tw - 10, -hSize - 10, tw * 2 + 20, hSize + 20);

    // Slick broth-soaked lower edge fading cleanly into warm amber soup
    const wetBand = g.createLinearGradient(0, -hSize * 0.32, 0, 2);
    wetBand.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(10, 10, 6, 0)');
    wetBand.addColorStop(0.48, 'rgba(12, 8, 4, 0.56)');
    wetBand.addColorStop(0.85, 'rgba(54, 24, 6, 0.86)');
    wetBand.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(84, 38, 10, 0.95)');
    g.fillStyle = wetBand;
    g.fillRect(-tw - 10, -hSize * 0.34, tw * 2 + 20, hSize * 0.38);
    g.restore();

    g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(148, 168, 126, 0.22)';
    g.lineWidth = 1.0;
    g.beginPath();
    g.moveTo(-tw + curl, -hSize);
    g.quadraticCurveTo(0, -hSize - hSize * 0.035, tw + curl, -hSize + hSize * 0.02);
    g.stroke();

    return { canvas: c, ox, oy };
  }

  function sampleWakeForce(px, py) {
    let fx = 0;
    let fy = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < wakes.length; i++) {
      const wk = wakes[i];
      const dx = px - wk.x;
      const dy = py - wk.y;
      const distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy;
      const rSq = wk.r * wk.r;
      if (distSq < rSq * 3.0) {
        const falloff = Math.exp(-distSq / (rSq * 0.78)) * wk.strength;
        fx += wk.vx * falloff * 0.90;
        fy += wk.vy * falloff * 0.90;
        const dist = Math.sqrt(distSq) + 1;
        const swirl = (wk.vx * dy - wk.vy * dx) / (dist * wk.r);
        fx += (-dy / dist) * swirl * falloff * 32;
        fy += (dx / dist) * swirl * falloff * 32;
      }
    }
    return { fx, fy };
  }

  const liveSteamRng = mulberry32(88421);

  function stepSteam(dt, timeSec, isPrewarm) {
    const scale = L.R / 215;
    const warmthMult = 1 + ptr.warmthBoost * 0.35;

    // 1) Advect soft volumetric vapor billows
    for (let i = 0; i < steamPuffs.length; i++) {
      const p = steamPuffs[i];
      p.age += dt;
      if (p.age >= p.maxLife) {
        steamPuffs[i] = spawnSteamPuff(liveSteamRng, 0);
        continue;
      }

      const lifeT = p.age / p.maxLife;
      const nx = p.x / (L.R * 0.85);
      const ny = p.y / (L.R * 0.85);
      const c = curlNoise(nx * 1.05 + p.seed * 0.03, ny * 1.05 - timeSec * 0.26, timeSec);

      // Strong organic curling & gentle lateral blooming as vapor ascends
      const curlGain = (26 + lifeT * 38) * scale;
      const targetVx = c.vx * curlGain + Math.sin(timeSec * 0.55 + p.seed + lifeT * 3.2) * 14 * scale;
      const targetVy = -(24 + 24 * (1 - lifeT * 0.48)) * scale * warmthMult + c.vy * 16 * scale;

      p.vx = lerp(p.vx, targetVx, Math.min(1, dt * 2.0));
      p.vy = lerp(p.vy, targetVy, Math.min(1, dt * 2.0));

      if (!isPrewarm && wakes.length > 0) {
        const wf = sampleWakeForce(p.x, p.y);
        p.vx += wf.fx * dt * 4.5;
        p.vy += wf.fy * dt * 4.5;
      }

      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      p.rot += p.rotSpd * dt;
    }

    // 2) Advect continuous curling silk vapor ribbons
    const segStep = L.R * 0.068;
    for (let r = 0; r < steamRibbons.length; r++) {
      const rb = steamRibbons[r];
      const pts = rb.pts;
      pts[0].x = rb.baseX + Math.sin(timeSec * 0.60 + rb.phase) * L.R * 0.07;
      pts[0].y = rb.baseY + Math.cos(timeSec * 0.45 + rb.phase * 1.3) * L.R * 0.025;

      for (let s = pts.length - 1; s >= 1; s--) {
        const prev = pts[s - 1];
        const curr = pts[s];
        const frac = s / (pts.length - 1);

        const pull = Math.min(1, dt * 7.2 * rb.riseSpeed);
        const riseDy = segStep * rb.heightFactor * (0.72 + frac * 0.50) * warmthMult;
        let tx = prev.x;
        let ty = prev.y - riseDy;

        // Graceful sweeping S-curls driven by curl noise + harmonic convective waves
        const c = curlNoise(
          curr.x / (L.R * 0.72) + rb.noiseOff * 0.06,
          curr.y / (L.R * 0.72) - timeSec * 0.32,
          timeSec
        );
        const swirlGain = (16 + frac * 54) * scale;
        const sWave = Math.sin(timeSec * 1.05 - frac * 5.2 + rb.phase) * rb.swayDir * frac * L.R * 0.038;
        tx += c.vx * swirlGain * dt * 4.4 + sWave;
        ty += c.vy * swirlGain * dt * 1.6;

        if (!isPrewarm && wakes.length > 0) {
          const wf = sampleWakeForce(curr.x, curr.y);
          curr.vx = lerp(curr.vx, wf.fx * (0.4 + frac * 1.0), Math.min(1, dt * 8));
          curr.vy = lerp(curr.vy, wf.fy * (0.4 + frac * 1.0), Math.min(1, dt * 8));
        } else {
          curr.vx *= Math.pow(0.14, dt);
          curr.vy *= Math.pow(0.14, dt);
        }

        curr.x = lerp(curr.x, tx, pull) + curr.vx * dt * 0.72;
        curr.y = lerp(curr.y, ty, pull) + curr.vy * dt * 0.72;
      }
    }
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 8. Layout & Resize Management
  // =========================================================================
  function updateLayout() {
    W = window.innerWidth;
    H = window.innerHeight;
    dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);

    canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(W * dpr));
    canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(H * dpr));

    const aspect = W / Math.max(1, H);
    let r;
    if (aspect < 0.85) {
      r = Math.min(W * 0.415, H * 0.25);
    } else if (aspect > 2.0) {
      r = Math.min(W * 0.25, H * 0.365);
    } else {
      r = Math.min(W * 0.32, H * 0.372);
    }
    r = clamp(r, 95, 360);

    L.R = r;
    L.cx = W * 0.5;
    L.cy = aspect < 0.85 ? H * 0.61 : H * 0.60;
    L.ryRatio = 0.585;
    L.rimRx = r;
    L.rimRy = r * L.ryRatio;
    L.innerRx = r * 0.936;
    L.innerRy = L.rimRy * 0.936;
    L.innerOffY = r * 0.015;
    L.brothOffY = r * 0.088;
    L.brothRx = r * 0.902;
    L.brothRy = L.rimRy * 0.902;
    L.bowlDepth = r * 0.84;

    if (cache.steamBrushes.length === 0) {
      buildSteamBrushes();
    }

    // Offscreen soft volumetric steam buffer (fast half-res for gossamer blur!)
    cache.steamScale = 0.55;
    cache.steamLayer = makeCanvas(Math.ceil(W * cache.steamScale), Math.ceil(H * cache.steamScale));
    cache.steamCtx = cache.steamLayer.getContext('2d');

    buildBackdropCache();

    if (Math.abs(cache.builtR - L.R) > 2 || !cache.bowlBack) {
      buildBowlCaches();
      buildBrothBaseCache();
      buildIngredientCaches();
      cache.builtR = L.R;
    }

    if (noodles.length === 0) {
      initSceneData();
    }
    initSteamSystem();

    if (reducedMotion) {
      renderFrame(0);
    }
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 9. Drawing Routines
  // =========================================================================
  function brothToLocal(bx, by) {
    return {
      x: bx * L.brothRx,
      y: L.brothOffY + by * L.brothRy
    };
  }

  // Sweeping Hand-Folded Wavy Ramen Noodles (Chijire-men)
  function drawNoodles(g, timeSec, pass) {
    const R = L.R;
    const baseThick = Math.max(2.3, R * 0.021);
    const steps = 28;

    function spinePoint(t) {
      const x = lerp(-0.56, 0.36, t) + Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * 0.05;
      const y = 0.58 - Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * 0.56 + Math.sin(t * Math.PI * 2) * 0.045;
      return { x, y };
    }

    function spineNormal(t) {
      const e = 0.01;
      const p0 = spinePoint(Math.max(0, t - e));
      const p1 = spinePoint(Math.min(1, t + e));
      const dx = p1.x - p0.x;
      const dy = p1.y - p0.y;
      const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
      return { nx: -dy / len, ny: dx / len };
    }

    g.lineCap = 'round';
    g.lineJoin = 'round';

    for (let i = 0; i < noodles.length; i++) {
      const nd = noodles[i];
      const pts = [];
      for (let s = 0; s <= steps; s++) {
        const t = s / steps;
        const sp = spinePoint(t);
        const nm = spineNormal(t);

        const pinch = 0.70 + Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * 0.36;
        const lateral = nd.spread * 0.25 * pinch + lerp(nd.startOff, nd.endOff, t);
        const breathe = reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.sin(timeSec * 0.85 + nd.phase + t * 3.0) * 0.004;
        const crinkle = Math.sin(t * nd.crinkleFreq + nd.phase) * nd.crinkleAmp + breathe;

        const bx = sp.x + nm.nx * (lateral + crinkle);
        const by = sp.y + nm.ny * (lateral + crinkle);

        const arch = Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * nd.crestBoost - 0.25;
        const loc = brothToLocal(bx, by);
        const liftY = Math.max(0, arch) * R * 0.052;
        pts.push({ x: loc.x, y: loc.y - liftY, h: arch });
      }

      if (pass === 'submerged') {
        g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(226, 156, 62, 0.24)';
        g.lineWidth = baseThick * nd.widthScale * 1.18;
        g.beginPath();
        for (let s = 0; s <= steps; s++) {
          if (s === 0) g.moveTo(pts[s].x, pts[s].y + 2);
          else g.lineTo(pts[s].x, pts[s].y + 2);
        }
        g.stroke();
        continue;
      }

      let sStart = -1;
      let sEnd = -1;
      for (let s = 0; s <= steps; s++) {
        if (pts[s].h > -0.02) {
          if (sStart === -1) sStart = s;
          sEnd = s;
        }
      }
      if (sStart === -1 || sEnd - sStart < 2) continue;

      const w = baseThick * nd.widthScale;

      function traceSubPath(offX, offY) {
        g.beginPath();
        for (let s = sStart; s <= sEnd; s++) {
          const p = pts[s];
          if (s === sStart) g.moveTo(p.x + offX, p.y + offY);
          else g.lineTo(p.x + offX, p.y + offY);
        }
      }

      // Rich umber depth shadow between individual strands
      g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(68, 25, 4, 0.56)';
      g.lineWidth = w * 1.24;
      traceSubPath(w * 0.22, w * 0.36);
      g.stroke();

      const pFirst = pts[sStart];
      const pMid = pts[(sStart + sEnd) >> 1];
      const pLast = pts[sEnd];
      const bodyGrad = g.createLinearGradient(pFirst.x, pFirst.y, pLast.x, pLast.y);
      const rShift = nd.shadeShift;
      bodyGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(182, 102, 26, 0.30)');
      bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.18, `rgb(${clamp(232 + rShift, 195, 252)}, ${clamp(182 + rShift * 0.7, 148, 214)}, 96)`);
      bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.50, `rgb(${clamp(248 + rShift * 0.5, 222, 255)}, ${clamp(214 + rShift * 0.5, 186, 236)}, 136)`);
      bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.82, `rgb(${clamp(218 + rShift, 182, 240)}, ${clamp(164 + rShift * 0.7, 132, 196)}, 80)`);
      bodyGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(166, 86, 20, 0.26)');
      g.strokeStyle = bodyGrad;
      g.lineWidth = w;
      traceSubPath(0, 0);
      g.stroke();

      // Glossy broth-coated highlight along noodle crest
      const specGrad = g.createLinearGradient(pFirst.x, pFirst.y, pLast.x, pLast.y);
      specGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 250, 232, 0)');
      specGrad.addColorStop(0.26, 'rgba(255, 248, 222, 0.44)');
      specGrad.addColorStop(0.50, 'rgba(255, 253, 242, 0.74)');
      specGrad.addColorStop(0.76, 'rgba(255, 244, 210, 0.26)');
      specGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 240, 200, 0)');
      g.strokeStyle = specGrad;
      g.lineWidth = Math.max(0.95, w * 0.32);
      traceSubPath(-w * 0.14, -w * 0.18);
      g.stroke();

      if (i % 5 === 0 && pMid.h > 0.22) {
        g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 253, 242, 0.56)';
        g.beginPath();
        g.ellipse(pMid.x - w * 0.1, pMid.y - w * 0.16, w * 0.40, w * 0.18, -0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        g.fill();
      }
    }
  }

      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(pos.x + 0.6, pos.y + 0.8, rx * 1.09, ry * 1.09, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();

      // Luminous glowing translucent interior
      const rg = g.createRadialGradient(
        pos.x + rx * 0.16, pos.y + ry * 0.20, rx * 0.06,
        pos.x, pos.y, rx * 1.05
      );
      if (d.hueShift > 0.35) {
        rg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 148, 38, 0.90)');
        rg.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(224, 54, 12, 0.82)');

        rg.addColorStop(0.62, 'rgba(232, 136, 30, 0.72)');
        rg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(165, 76, 12, 0.44)');
      }
      g.fillStyle = rg;
      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(pos.x, pos.y, rx, ry, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();

      // Crisp bright specular oil spark tracking overhead light
      if (rx > 1.7) {
        const sx = pos.x - rx * 0.30 + lightOffX * Math.min(2.4, rx * 0.26);
        const sy = pos.y - ry * 0.30 + lightOffY * Math.min(1.6, ry * 0.26);
        g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 252, 238, 0.88)';
        g.beginPath();
        g.ellipse(sx, sy, Math.max(0.85, rx * 0.28), Math.max(0.6, ry * 0.22), -0.35, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        g.fill();
      }
    }
  }

  function drawRipples(g) {

      const radX = rp.maxR * easeOut;

      g.ellipse(rp.x, rp.y, radX, radY, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);

        g.ellipse(rp.x, rp.y, radX * 0.88, radY * 0.88, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);

    }
  }

      const sway = reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.sin(timeSec * 1.6 + th.phase) * 0.006;
      const p0 = brothToLocal(th.x0, th.y0);
      const p1 = brothToLocal(th.x1 + sway, th.y1 - 0.05);
      const p2 = brothToLocal(th.x2 - sway * 0.8, th.y2 - 0.06);
      const p3 = brothToLocal(th.x3 + sway * 1.3, th.y3 - 0.02);

      g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(48, 10, 4, 0.38)';
      g.lineWidth = th.thick * (R / 215) * 1.45;
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(p0.x + 1.5, p0.y + 3);
      g.bezierCurveTo(p1.x + 1.5, p1.y + 4, p2.x + 1.5, p2.y + 4, p3.x + 1.5, p3.y + 3);
      g.stroke();

      const cg = g.createLinearGradient(p0.x, p0.y, p3.x, p3.y);
      cg.addColorStop(0, '#9a160a');
      cg.addColorStop(0.45, '#e8341c');
      cg.addColorStop(0.75, '#ff6a3c');
      cg.addColorStop(1, '#b41c0e');
      g.strokeStyle = cg;
      g.lineWidth = Math.max(0.95, th.thick * (R / 215));
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(p0.x, p0.y);
      g.bezierCurveTo(p1.x, p1.y, p2.x, p2.y, p3.x, p3.y);
      g.stroke();
    }
    g.restore();
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Seamless Photographic Volumetric Steam Renderer (Offscreen Soft-Blur Layer)
  // =========================================================================
  function renderSteamLayer(bowlX, bowlY, lightShiftX) {
    const sg = cache.steamCtx;
    const sc = cache.steamScale;
    const sw = cache.steamLayer.width;
    const sh = cache.steamLayer.height;
    const R = L.R;
    const beamCenterX = lightShiftX * R * 0.25;

    sg.save();
    sg.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
    sg.clearRect(0, 0, sw, sh);
    sg.scale(sc, sc);
    sg.translate(bowlX, bowlY);
    sg.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';

    // 1) Soft low-hanging luminous vapor haze hugging the hot broth surface
    const hazeGrad = sg.createRadialGradient(0, L.brothOffY - R * 0.08, R * 0.06, 0, L.brothOffY - R * 0.14, R * 0.92);
    hazeGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 224, 174, ${0.14 + ptr.warmthBoost * 0.06})`);
    hazeGrad.addColorStop(0.55, `rgba(255, 212, 162, ${0.055 + ptr.warmthBoost * 0.03})`);
    hazeGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 212, 162, 0)');
    sg.fillStyle = hazeGrad;
    sg.beginPath();
    sg.ellipse(0, L.brothOffY - R * 0.12, R * 0.92, R * 0.44, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    sg.fill();

    // 2) Billowing Volumetric Vapor Plumes (soft organic cloud puffs)
    for (let i = 0; i < steamPuffs.length; i++) {
      const p = steamPuffs[i];
      const lifeT = clamp(p.age / p.maxLife, 0, 1);
      // Graceful fade-in near broth, soft bloom, complete dissolution before top edge!
      const screenY = bowlY + p.y;
      const topFade = smoothstep(H * 0.04, H * 0.26, screenY);
      const env = smoothstep(0, 0.18, lifeT) * (1 - smoothstep(0.38, 1.0, lifeT)) * topFade;
      if (env <= 0.002) continue;

      const beamDist = Math.abs(p.x - beamCenterX) / (R * 1.25);
      const beamBoost = 0.52 + 0.65 * Math.exp(-beamDist * beamDist * 1.2);
      const alpha = p.alphaMax * env * beamBoost * (1 + ptr.warmthBoost * 0.28);

      const size = p.baseSize * (0.68 + lifeT * 1.85);
      const stretchY = 1.10 + (1 - lifeT) * 0.35;
      const tilt = clamp(p.vx * 0.009, -0.55, 0.55);

      sg.save();
      sg.translate(p.x, p.y);
      sg.rotate(tilt + p.rot * 0.16);
      sg.scale(1.0, stretchY);
      sg.globalAlpha = clamp(alpha, 0, 0.34);
      sg.drawImage(cache.steamBrushes[p.brush], -size * 0.5, -size * 0.5, size, size);
      sg.restore();
    }

    // 3) Seamless Tapered Silk Vapor Ribbons (SINGLE closed polygon per ribbon — ZERO beading!)
    sg.globalAlpha = 1;
    for (let r = 0; r < steamRibbons.length; r++) {
      const rb = steamRibbons[r];
      const pts = rb.pts;
      const n = pts.length;
      if (n < 5) continue;

      const leftPts = [];
      const rightPts = [];
      let minY = Infinity;
      let maxY = -Infinity;

      for (let s = 0; s < n; s++) {
        const frac = s / (n - 1);
        const p = pts[s];
        const pPrev = pts[Math.max(0, s - 1)];
        const pNext = pts[Math.min(n - 1, s + 1)];
        const tx = pNext.x - pPrev.x;
        const ty = pNext.y - pPrev.y;
        const tLen = Math.hypot(tx, ty) || 1;
        const nx = -ty / tLen;
        const ny = tx / tLen;

        // Taper smoothly: narrow wispy base -> lush billowing middle -> softly expanding feather aloft
        const halfW = rb.widthBase * (0.28 + Math.sin(frac * Math.PI * 0.85) * 1.15 + frac * 0.72);
        leftPts.push({ x: p.x + nx * halfW, y: p.y + ny * halfW });
        rightPts.push({ x: p.x - nx * halfW, y: p.y - ny * halfW });
        if (p.y < minY) minY = p.y;
        if (p.y > maxY) maxY = p.y;
      }

      if (maxY - minY < 12) continue;

      const midX = pts[n >> 1].x;
      const beamDist = Math.abs(midX - beamCenterX) / (R * 1.15);
      const beamLit = 0.55 + 0.65 * Math.exp(-beamDist * beamDist * 1.3);
      const peakA = clamp(rb.alpha * beamLit * (1 + ptr.warmthBoost * 0.30), 0, 0.24);

      // Single seamless vertical fade gradient along entire ribbon (ZERO segment overlap!)
      const grad = sg.createLinearGradient(0, maxY, 0, minY);
      grad.addColorStop(0.0, 'rgba(255, 224, 174, 0)');
      grad.addColorStop(0.14, `rgba(255, 228, 184, ${peakA * 0.82})`);
      grad.addColorStop(0.38, `rgba(255, 236, 206, ${peakA})`);
      grad.addColorStop(0.72, `rgba(246, 238, 228, ${peakA * 0.42})`);
      grad.addColorStop(1.0, 'rgba(242, 238, 232, 0)');

      sg.fillStyle = grad;
      sg.beginPath();
      sg.moveTo(leftPts[0].x, leftPts[0].y);
      for (let s = 1; s < n - 1; s++) {
        const mx = (leftPts[s].x + leftPts[s + 1].x) * 0.5;
        const my = (leftPts[s].y + leftPts[s + 1].y) * 0.5;
        sg.quadraticCurveTo(leftPts[s].x, leftPts[s].y, mx, my);
      }
      sg.lineTo(leftPts[n - 1].x, leftPts[n - 1].y);
      sg.lineTo(rightPts[n - 1].x, rightPts[n - 1].y);
      for (let s = n - 2; s >= 1; s--) {
        const mx = (rightPts[s].x + rightPts[s - 1].x) * 0.5;
        const my = (rightPts[s].y + rightPts[s - 1].y) * 0.5;
        sg.quadraticCurveTo(rightPts[s].x, rightPts[s].y, mx, my);
      }
      sg.lineTo(rightPts[0].x, rightPts[0].y);
      sg.closePath();
      sg.fill();
    }

    // Smooth vertical mask fade at very top of canvas so steam NEVER clips against top border!
    sg.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
    sg.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-in';
    const topMask = sg.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, sh * 0.30);
    topMask.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
    topMask.addColorStop(0.45, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55)');
    topMask.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)');
    sg.fillStyle = topMask;
    sg.fillRect(0, 0, sw, sh * 0.32);
    sg.fillStyle = '#000';
    sg.fillRect(0, sh * 0.30, sw, sh * 0.72);

    sg.restore();

    // Composite the soft volumetric steam onto the main scene with dual-pass feathery glow!
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';
    // Soft enveloping mist pass
    ctx.filter = 'blur(9px)';
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.88;
    ctx.drawImage(cache.steamLayer, 0, 0, W, H);
    // Finer silk curling wisp pass
    ctx.filter = 'blur(2.5px)';
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.58;
    ctx.drawImage(cache.steamLayer, 0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.filter = 'none';
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // Seamless Warm Overhead Atmospheric Glow & Floating Bokeh Motes (ZERO hard cone edges!)
  function drawOverheadLightAndMotes(g, timeSec, lightShiftX) {

    // 2) Intimate warm radiance rising directly from the hot ramen bowl
    const brothAura = g.createRadialGradient(

    );

    g.fillStyle = brothAura;
    g.beginPath();
    g.arc(L.cx, L.cy - R * 0.08, R * 1.58, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.fill();

    // 3) Subtle warm golden bokeh dust motes drifting lazily in the light
    for (let i = 0; i < motes.length; i++) {
      const m = motes[i];
      const mx = L.cx + m.nx * R * 1.15 - ptr.nx * 10;
      const my = L.cy + m.ny * R * 0.86 - ptr.ny * 8;
      if (my < -20 || my > H + 20) continue;

      const beamDist = Math.abs(mx - (L.cx + lightShiftX * R * 0.2)) / (R * 1.25);
      const twinkle = reducedMotion ? 0.8 : (0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(timeSec * 1.4 + m.phase));
      const a = m.alpha * twinkle * Math.exp(-beamDist * beamDist * 1.2) * smoothstep(0, H * 0.22, my);
      if (a <= 0.01) continue;

      const mg = g.createRadialGradient(mx, my, 0, mx, my, m.r * 2.5);
      mg.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 224, 168, ${a})`);
      mg.addColorStop(0.45, `rgba(255, 188, 112, ${a * 0.35})`);
      mg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 188, 112, 0)');
      g.fillStyle = mg;
      g.beginPath();
      g.arc(mx, my, m.r * 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
    }

    g.restore();
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 10. Main Frame Update & Composite Render
  // =========================================================================
  function stepSimulation(dt) {
    elapsed += dt;

    const damp = Math.min(1, dt * 4.5);
    if (ptr.active) {
      const targetNx = clamp((ptr.rawX - L.cx) / (W * 0.5), -1, 1);
      const targetNy = clamp((ptr.rawY - L.cy) / (H * 0.5), -1, 1);
      ptr.nx = lerp(ptr.nx, targetNx, damp);
      ptr.ny = lerp(ptr.ny, targetNy, damp);
    } else {
      ptr.nx = lerp(ptr.nx, 0, Math.min(1, dt * 1.5));
      ptr.ny = lerp(ptr.ny, 0, Math.min(1, dt * 1.5));
    }

    ptr.warmthBoost = lerp(ptr.warmthBoost, ptr.overBroth ? 1 : 0, Math.min(1, dt * 3.0));

    for (let i = wakes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      wakes[i].age += dt;
      wakes[i].strength *= Math.pow(0.08, dt);
      if (wakes[i].age > 1.2 || wakes[i].strength < 0.015) {
        wakes.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }

    for (let i = ripples.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const rp = ripples[i];
      rp.age += dt;
      if (rp.age >= rp.maxAge) {
        ripples.splice(i, 1);
        continue;
      }
      const t = rp.age / rp.maxAge;
      const waveR = rp.maxR * (1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 2.4));
      const band = L.R * 0.08;
      const pushStr = (1 - t) * rp.strength * 0.014 * dt * 60;

      for (let j = 0; j < rayuDroplets.length; j++) {
        const d = rayuDroplets[j];
        const pos = brothToLocal(d.bx + d.dx, d.by + d.dy);
        const dx = pos.x - rp.x;
        const dy = (pos.y - rp.y) / L.ryRatio;
        const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
        if (Math.abs(dist - waveR) < band && dist > 1) {
          d.dx += (dx / dist) * pushStr * 0.28;
          d.dy += (dy / dist) * pushStr * 0.28;
        }
      }
      for (let j = 0; j < scallions.length; j++) {
        const s = scallions[j];
        if (!s.floating) continue;
        const pos = brothToLocal(s.bx + s.dx, s.by + s.dy);
        const dx = pos.x - rp.x;
        const dy = (pos.y - rp.y) / L.ryRatio;
        const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
        if (Math.abs(dist - waveR) < band && dist > 1) {
          s.dx += (dx / dist) * pushStr * 0.18;
          s.dy += (dy / dist) * pushStr * 0.18;
        }
      }
    }

    const ret = Math.pow(0.28, dt);
    for (let j = 0; j < rayuDroplets.length; j++) {
      rayuDroplets[j].dx *= ret;
      rayuDroplets[j].dy *= ret;
    }
    for (let j = 0; j < scallions.length; j++) {
      scallions[j].dx *= ret;
      scallions[j].dy *= ret;
    }
    for (let j = 0; j < sesameSeeds.length; j++) {
      sesameSeeds[j].dx *= ret;
      sesameSeeds[j].dy *= ret;
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < motes.length; i++) {
      const m = motes[i];
      m.nx += (m.vx + Math.sin(elapsed * 0.5 + m.phase) * 0.008) * dt;
      m.ny += m.vy * dt;
      if (m.ny < -2.4) {
        m.ny = -0.15;
        m.nx = (liveSteamRng() - 0.5) * 1.25;
      }
    }

    stepSteam(dt, elapsed, false);
  }
